<!-- Brand font. PORT NOTE: consider self-hosting to shave a request. -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
/* ============================================================
   DESIGN SYSTEM — brand palette (from brand-assets repo)
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --teal:#0A6B70;
  --teal-dark:#085A61;
  --teal-deep:#064A50;
  --amber:#F4B400;
  --amber-dark:#D99E00;
  --red:#E53935;
  --paper:#FAFAF8;
  --ink:#1B1B1B;
  --ink-soft:#4A4A46;
  --line:#E5E1D8;
  --card:#FFFFFF;
  --sand:#F3EFE6;
  --radius:14px;
  --shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(27,27,27,.07);
  --shadow-lg:0 10px 34px rgba(6,74,80,.16);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);
  line-height:1.6;font-size:17px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:var(--teal)}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
section{padding:72px 0}
@media(max-width:767px){section{padding:52px 0}body{font-size:16px}}

/* Typography hierarchy (Principle 45) */
h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,5.5vw,3.3rem);line-height:1.12;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.5vw,2.2rem);line-height:1.2;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin-bottom:14px}
h3{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.kicker{display:inline-block;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:12px}
.sub{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:1.06rem;max-width:640px}
.center{text-align:center}
.center .sub{margin:0 auto}

/* Buttons — ≥44px touch targets (Principle 32) */
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  min-height:52px;padding:14px 30px;border-radius:999px;
  font-family:inherit;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
  text-decoration:none;border:none;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s,background .15s;
}
.btn-primary{
  background:var(--amber);color:var(--ink);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(244,180,0,.4);
}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--amber-dark);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(244,180,0,.5)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#fff}
.textlink{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--teal);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.riskreversal{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px}
.hero .riskreversal,.finalcta .riskreversal{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}

/* Cards & grids */
.cards{display:grid;gap:20px}
@media(min-width:768px){.cards-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.cards-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.card p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.97rem}

/* Checklist bullets — parallel structure (Principle 44) */
ul.checks{list-style:none;margin-top:12px}
ul.checks li{padding-left:30px;position:relative;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
ul.checks li::before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;color:var(--teal);font-weight:800}

/* Header */
header{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
  background:var(--teal-dark);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(250,250,248,.14);
  transition:transform .28s ease;
}
header.hdr-hidden{transform:translateY(-100%)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:64px;gap:16px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.logo-badge{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--teal);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:800}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:center}
.nav-links a{color:rgba(250,250,248,.85);text-decoration:none;font-size:.93rem;font-weight:600}
.nav-links a:hover{color:#fff}
.nav .btn{min-height:44px;padding:10px 22px;font-size:.95rem}
@media(max-width:860px){.nav-links{display:none}}

/* Hero */
.hero{
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--teal-deep) 0%,var(--teal) 62%,var(--teal-dark) 100%);
  color:#fff;padding:84px 0 90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-180px;top:-180px;width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(244,180,0,.09)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;gap:48px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
@media(min-width:960px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr}}
.hero .kicker{color:var(--amber)}
.hero h1{color:#fff}
.hero .sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);margin:18px 0 26px}
.trust-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 22px;margin-top:30px;font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.trust-strip span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}

/* Score card mock (hero visual, Principle 5/38) */
.scorecard{
  background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:20px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);padding:28px;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;
}
.scorecard .sc-label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.gauge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin:16px 0 20px}
.dial{
  width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  background:conic-gradient(var(--red) 0deg 223deg,var(--line) 223deg 360deg);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.dial-inner{width:82px;height:82px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.dial-inner b{font-size:1.9rem;line-height:1}
.dial-inner small{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:.06em}
.band-chip{display:inline-block;background:#FDECEA;color:var(--red);font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:6px}
.gauge p{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.sc-task{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.88rem;gap:12px}
.sc-task .pct{font-weight:800;color:var(--teal);white-space:nowrap}
.sc-task.blurred{filter:blur(4px);user-select:none}
.sc-foot{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;margin-top:12px}

/* Stats bar (Principle 13) */
.stats{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:38px 0}
.stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:26px;text-align:center}
@media(min-width:768px){.stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.stat b{display:block;font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--amber)}
.stat span{font-size:.85rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}

/* Before / After (Principle 38) */
.ba-grid{display:grid;gap:20px}
@media(min-width:768px){.ba-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.ba{border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px}
.ba-before{background:var(--sand);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.ba-after{background:var(--teal);color:#fff}
.ba h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ba ul{list-style:none;margin-top:10px}
.ba li{padding-left:26px;position:relative;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:.95rem}
.ba-before p,.ba-before li{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.ba-after p,.ba-after li{color:var(--paper)}
.ba-before li::before{content:"✕";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.ba-after li::before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--amber);font-weight:800}

/* Steps (Principle 40) */
.steps{counter-reset:step;display:grid;gap:20px}
@media(min-width:768px){.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.step{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;position:relative}
.step::before{
  counter-increment:step;content:counter(step);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);color:#fff;
  font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px;
}
.step p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.95rem}

/* Comparison table (Principle 9)
   M1 responsive pattern: desktop shows the full 4-column table;
   mobile (<768px) swaps to a 2-column "You vs. the rest" table
   with competitors honestly aggregated. No horizontal scroll. */
.compare-scroll{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--card);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.compare-mobile-wrap{display:none}
@media(max-width:767px){
  .compare-desktop-wrap{display:none}
  .compare-mobile-wrap{display:block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--card);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
  table.compare-m{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.8rem;table-layout:fixed}
  .compare-m th,.compare-m td{padding:10px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;text-align:left}
  .compare-m thead th{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:800}
  .compare-m thead th.us{background:var(--teal);color:#fff;width:35%}
  .compare-m td.us{background:rgba(10,107,112,.06);font-weight:700;color:var(--teal-dark)}
  .compare-m td.q{font-weight:700;background:var(--sand);color:var(--ink)}
  .compare-m .yes{color:var(--teal);font-weight:800}
  .compare-m .no{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
}
table.compare{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:860px;font-size:.9rem}
.compare th,.compare td{padding:14px 16px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
.compare th:first-child,.compare td:first-child{text-align:left;font-weight:600;max-width:270px}
.compare thead th{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:800}
.compare thead th.us{background:var(--teal);color:#fff}
.compare td.us{background:rgba(10,107,112,.06);font-weight:700;color:var(--teal-dark)}
.compare .yes{color:var(--teal);font-weight:800}
.compare .no{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
.compare-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px}

/* Testimonials (Principles 11–12, 15) */
.tcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.tcard .quote{font-size:.97rem;color:var(--ink)}
.tperson{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:auto}
.avatar{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sand);border:1px dashed var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.6rem;color:var(--teal);text-align:center}
.tperson b{display:block;font-size:.92rem}
.tperson span{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.stars{color:var(--amber);letter-spacing:2px}
.video-slot{
  border:2px dashed var(--teal);border-radius:var(--radius);
  min-height:220px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:8px;color:var(--teal);background:rgba(10,107,112,.04);margin-top:24px;text-align:center;padding:20px;
}
.placeholder-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--red);font-weight:600}

/* Founder (Principle 29) */
.founder{display:grid;gap:28px;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:768px){.founder{grid-template-columns:220px 1fr}}
.founder-photo{width:200px;height:200px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--sand);border:2px dashed var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;color:var(--teal);font-size:.85rem;padding:14px}
.founder-links{margin-top:12px;display:flex;gap:16px;font-size:.9rem}

/* Pricing (Principles 21–25) */
.plans{display:grid;gap:22px;align-items:stretch}
@media(min-width:900px){.plans{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.plan{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative}
.plan.popular{border:3px solid var(--amber);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.popular-badge{
  position:absolute;top:-15px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  background:var(--amber);color:var(--ink);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;
  padding:5px 16px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;
}
.price{font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:800;margin:8px 0 2px}
.price small{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.plan .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%}
.plan ul.checks{margin-bottom:22px}
.plan .note{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px}

/* Truthful scarcity (Principle 37) */
.scarcity{
  display:inline-block;
  background:rgba(244,180,0,.14);border:1px solid var(--amber);
  color:var(--ink);font-size:.86rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;
  padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:16px;
}

/* Urgency (Principle 37) */
.urgency{background:var(--sand);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:40px 0}
.urgency .wrap{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;max-width:860px}
.urgency .flag{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1}

/* Not-for (Principle 41) */
ul.notfor{list-style:none;margin-top:14px;max-width:680px}
ul.notfor li{padding-left:30px;position:relative;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
ul.notfor li::before{content:"✕";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--red);font-weight:800}

/* FAQ (Principle 26) - always open: full text visible to users, crawlers, and AI */
.faq{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
.faq .qa{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}
.faq .qa h3{padding:18px 22px 0;font-weight:700;font-size:1.02rem;margin:0}
.faq .a{padding:10px 22px 18px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.96rem;margin:0}

/* Final CTA */
.finalcta{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--teal) 0%,var(--teal-deep) 100%);color:#fff;text-align:center}
.finalcta h2{color:#fff}
.finalcta .sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);margin:0 auto 26px}

/* Footer (Principles 27–28, 30) */
footer{background:var(--ink);color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);padding:52px 0 32px;font-size:.88rem}
.foot-grid{display:grid;gap:30px;margin-bottom:34px}
@media(min-width:768px){.foot-grid{grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr}}
footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:12px}
footer a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);text-decoration:none;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
footer a:hover{color:var(--amber)}
.foot-badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.badge{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:.76rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.foot-legal{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);padding-top:22px;font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.foot-legal p{margin-bottom:6px}

/* Popup (Principle 35) */
.popup-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(27,27,27,.55);z-index:100;
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
}
.popup-overlay.show{display:flex}
.popup{background:var(--card);border-radius:20px;max-width:440px;width:100%;padding:34px;position:relative;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.popup-close{
  position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:44px;height:44px;border:none;background:none;
  font-size:1.5rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink-soft);border-radius:50%;
}
.popup-close:hover{background:var(--sand)}
.popup h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.popup p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:18px}
.popup form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.popup input[type=email]{
  min-height:50px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;
  font-family:inherit;font-size:1rem;
}
.popup .fine{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:8px 0 0}

/* Reduced motion */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.btn{transition:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<!-- ============================================================
     HEADER / NAV
     ============================================================ -->
<header>
  <div class="wrap nav">
    <a class="logo" href="/" aria-label="AI Job Risk Check home">
      <img src="/logo-horizontal.png" alt="AI Job Risk Check. Your job. Your score. Your plan." style="height:46px;width:auto;display:block" />
    </a>
    <nav class="nav-links" aria-label="Main">
      <a href="#how-it-works">How It Works</a>
      <a href="#why-us">Why It's Different</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
      <a href="/ai-job-risk">Occupations</a>
      <a href="/blog">Blog</a>
    </nav>
    <!-- Principle 3: ONE primary CTA. PORT NOTE: wire to the job-title typeahead (assessment start). -->
    <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#start">Get My Free Score</a>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ============================================================
     HERO (Principles 1–8, 42)
     UTM variants swap the H1/sub via JS — see script at bottom.
     ============================================================ -->
<section class="hero" id="start">
  <div class="wrap hero-grid">
    <div>
      <!-- Principle 6: name the target user explicitly -->
      <span class="kicker">For U.S. workers who want a real answer</span>
      <h1 id="hero-headline">Will AI take my job? Get a real answer.</h1>
      <p class="sub" id="hero-sub">Not a listicle. Not a guess. Rate how you actually spend your time and get your personal AI Risk Score, built from peer-reviewed task data. Free, in about 60 seconds. No signup.</p>
      <!-- Principle 3: first-person CTA. PORT NOTE: wire to typeahead. -->

<script>
/* ============================================================
   STICKY HEADER — mobile hide-on-scroll (standard direction-based
   pattern): slides away scrolling down, returns on any upward
   scroll, always visible near the top. Desktop: always pinned.
   ============================================================ */
(function () {
  var hdr = document.querySelector('header');
  if (!hdr) return;
  var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)');
  var lastY = window.scrollY;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    if (!mq.matches) { hdr.classList.remove('hdr-hidden'); return; }
    var y = window.scrollY;
    var dy = y - lastY;
    if (Math.abs(dy) < 8) return;           // ignore jitter
    if (y < 90 || dy < 0) hdr.classList.remove('hdr-hidden');
    else hdr.classList.add('hdr-hidden');
    lastY = y;
  }, { passive: true });
  mq.addEventListener && mq.addEventListener('change', function () { hdr.classList.remove('hdr-hidden'); });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   UTM-BASED HEADLINE SWAP (Principles 19–20)
   Default = cold paid traffic. Warm/content traffic and known
   sources get their own hero copy. Extend the map as needed.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var src = (params.get('utm_source')||'').toLowerCase();
  var med = (params.get('utm_medium')||'').toLowerCase();
  var h = document.getElementById('hero-headline');
  var s = document.getElementById('hero-sub');
  var variants = {
    reddit: {
      h: 'Reddit argues about this daily. Here’s your actual number.',
      s: 'Skip the thread wars. Rate how you really spend your time and get your personal AI Risk Score from peer-reviewed data. Free, in about 60 seconds. No signup.'
    },
    facebook: {
      h: 'Will AI take my job? Get a real answer.',
      s: 'Not a listicle. Not a guess. Rate how you actually spend your time and get your personal AI Risk Score. Free, in about 60 seconds. No signup.'
    },
    instagram: {
      h: 'Your job title isn’t your risk. Your tasks are.',
      s: 'Get your personal AI Risk Score from how you actually spend your week. Free, in about 60 seconds. No signup.'
    },
    warm: {
      h: 'You’ve read how the score works. Get yours.',
      s: 'You know the method: real tasks, time-weighted, peer-reviewed exposure data. Your own score takes about 60 seconds and costs nothing.'
    }
  };
  var v = null;
  if (variants[src]) v = variants[src];
  else if (['blog','newsletter','email','substack'].indexOf(src) >= 0 ||
           ['content','organic','referral','email'].indexOf(med) >= 0) v = variants.warm;
  if (v && h && s){ h.textContent = v.h; s.textContent = v.s; }
})();

/* ============================================================
   COACHING SPOTS COUNTER — truthful scarcity (Principle 37)
   COACHING_SPOTS_OPEN is the number of coaching spots genuinely
   available right now (0–5). Update it every time a spot fills
   or opens — NEVER show a number that isn't currently true.
   At 0, the line switches to a full/waitlist message — before you
   ever set 0, confirm that message matches what actually happens
   for a buyer while you're full (delayed start? waitlist?).
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  var COACHING_SPOTS_OPEN = 5; // ← edit honestly: 0–5
  var num = document.getElementById('spots-open');
  var line = document.getElementById('scarcity-line');
  if (!num || !line) return;
  if (COACHING_SPOTS_OPEN <= 0){
    line.textContent = '⏳ Coaching is 1:1 with the founder and currently full. Buy today and your coaching month starts when the next spot opens.';
  } else {
    num.textContent = COACHING_SPOTS_OPEN;
  }
})();

/* ============================================================
   POPUP: exit intent (desktop) or 60s timer — once per visit.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  var shown = false;
  var overlay = document.getElementById('popup');
  function show(){
    if (shown) return;
    shown = true;
    overlay.classList.add('show');
  }
  function hide(){ overlay.classList.remove('show'); }
  document.getElementById('popup-close').addEventListener('click', hide);
  overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if (e.target === overlay) hide(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if (e.key === 'Escape') hide(); });
  // Exit intent (desktop)
  document.addEventListener('mouseout', function(e){
    if (!e.relatedTarget && e.clientY <= 0) show();
  });
  // 60-second fallback on touch devices only; desktop keeps exit intent
  if (!window.matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches) setTimeout(show, 60000);

  // Lead magnet email capture -> existing .net email_list via PostgREST RPC.
  // The anon key below is the PUBLIC publishable key (safe to ship client-side).
  var SUPABASE_URL = 'https://jddygvtoyafewkrrhndk.supabase.co';
  var SUPABASE_ANON = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6ImpkZHlndnRveWFmZXdrcnJobmRrIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODUzNTEzNzksImV4cCI6MjEwMDkyNzM3OX0.mSoqQmYDoPQPrqEJKqbqgOfj4cZCtpT60qRHskHIVLc';
  document.getElementById('leadmagnet-form').addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var btn = document.getElementById('lm-btn');
    var email = document.getElementById('lm-email').value.trim();
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'One moment…';
    fetch(SUPABASE_URL + '/rest/v1/rpc/app_add_to_email_list', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'apikey': SUPABASE_ANON,
        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + SUPABASE_ANON
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ p_email: email, p_source: 'exit-popup-40-tasks' })
    }).then(function(r){
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('capture failed');
      document.getElementById('popup-form-state').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('popup-done-state').style.display = 'block';
    }).catch(function(){
      // Never hold the PDF hostage to a failed write: deliver anyway.
      document.getElementById('popup-form-state').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('popup-done-state').style.display = 'block';
    });
  });
})();
</script>

import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";

import { track } from "@/lib/analytics";
import { JourneyProgress } from "@/components/JourneyProgress";

const TEAL = "#0A6B70";
const AMBER = "#F4B400";
const SOFT = "#FAFAF8";
const CHARCOAL = "#1B1B1B";

const DISPLAY = "'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
const SANS = "Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";

export const HERO_INPUT_ID = "ajrc-hero-job-title";

const ONET_TITLES_URL =
  "https://jddygvtoyafewkrrhndk.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/public-assets/onet-alternate-titles.json";

type AltTitle = { t: string; c: string };
type RankedRow = { t: string; c: string; tl: string; rank: number };

let altTitlesCache: AltTitle[] | null = null;
let altTitlesPromise: Promise<AltTitle[]> | null = null;
let socMapCache: Map<string, string> | null = null;
let socMapPromise: Promise<Map<string, string>> | null = null;

function loadAltTitles(): Promise<AltTitle[]> {
  if (altTitlesCache) return Promise.resolve(altTitlesCache);
  if (altTitlesPromise) return altTitlesPromise;
  altTitlesPromise = fetch(ONET_TITLES_URL)
    .then((r) => r.json())
    .then((data: AltTitle[]) => {
      altTitlesCache = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
      return altTitlesCache;
    })
    .catch(() => {
      altTitlesPromise = null;
      return [] as AltTitle[];
    });
  return altTitlesPromise;
}

function loadSocMap(): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  if (socMapCache) return Promise.resolve(socMapCache);
  if (socMapPromise) return socMapPromise;
  socMapPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const { supabase } = await import("@/lib/supabase");
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("onet_occupations")
        .select("soc_code, title");
      if (error || !data) {
        socMapCache = new Map();
        return socMapCache;
      }
      const m = new Map<string, string>();
      for (const row of data as Array<{ soc_code: string; title: string }>) {
        m.set(row.soc_code, row.title);
      }
      socMapCache = m;
      return m;
    } catch {
      socMapCache = new Map();
      return socMapCache;
    }
  })();
  return socMapPromise;
}

function schedulePrefetch(fn: () => void) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const w = window as unknown as {
    requestIdleCallback?: (cb: () => void, opts?: { timeout: number }) => number;
  };
  if (typeof w.requestIdleCallback === "function") {
    w.requestIdleCallback(fn, { timeout: 2000 });
  } else {
    setTimeout(fn, 250);
  }
}

function rankMatches(query: string, source: AltTitle[]): AltTitle[] {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (q.length < 2) return [];
  const tokens = q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (tokens.length === 0) return [];
  const ranked: RankedRow[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i++) {
    const row = source[i];
    if (!row || typeof row.t !== "string") continue;
    const tl = row.t.toLowerCase();
    let allMatch = true;
    for (const tok of tokens) {
      if (!tl.includes(tok)) { allMatch = false; break; }
    }
    if (!allMatch) continue;
    let rank = 3;
    if (tl.startsWith(q)) rank = 1;
    else {
      for (const tok of tokens) {
        if (tl === tok || tl.startsWith(tok + " ") || tl.includes(" " + tok)) {
          rank = 2;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    const key = tl + "|" + row.c;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    ranked.push({ t: row.t, c: row.c, tl, rank });
  }
  ranked.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.rank !== b.rank) return a.rank - b.rank;
    return a.tl.length - b.tl.length;
  });
  return ranked.slice(0, 5).map(({ t, c }) => ({ t, c }));
}

export function HeroJobForm({
  showReassurance = true,
  variant = "form",
  hideProgress = false,
}: {
  showReassurance?: boolean;
  variant?: "form" | "cta";
  hideProgress?: boolean;
}) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [showPrompt, setShowPrompt] = useState(false);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<AltTitle[]>([]);
  const [socMapReady, setSocMapReady] = useState<boolean>(!!socMapCache);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<number>(10);
  const debounceRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    schedulePrefetch(() => { void loadAltTitles(); });
    schedulePrefetch(() => {
      void loadSocMap().then(() => setSocMapReady(true));
    });
  }, []);

  const runMatch = (q: string) => {
    const source = altTitlesCache;
    if (!source) {
      void loadAltTitles().then(() => {
        if (q === title.trim() && q.length >= 2) {
          setResults(rankMatches(q, altTitlesCache ?? []));
        }
      });
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }
    setResults(rankMatches(q, source));
  };

  const onChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const v = e.target.value;
    setTitle(v);
    if (v.length > 0 && progress < 22) setProgress(22);
    if (showPrompt) setShowPrompt(false);
    if (debounceRef.current !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    }
    const q = v.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }
    debounceRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => runMatch(q), 120);
  };

  const goFreeText = (raw: string) => {
    const trimmed = raw.trim();
    if (trimmed.length < 2) {
      setShowPrompt(true);
      return;
    }
    track("Assessment Started", { source: "freetext" });
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && (window as any).ttq) {
      (window as any).ttq.track("ClickButton", {
        contents: [{ content_name: "Get My Free Score" }],
      });
    }
    navigate({ to: "/assessment", search: { title: trimmed } });
  };

  const pickSuggestion = (row: AltTitle) => {
    const occ = socMapCache?.get(row.c) ?? row.t;
    track("Assessment Started", { source: "typeahead" });
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && (window as any).ttq) {
      (window as any).ttq.track("ClickButton", {
        contents: [{ content_name: "Get My Free Score" }],
      });
    }
    navigate({
      to: "/assessment",
      search: { title: row.t, soc: row.c, occ, conf: "1" },
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    goFreeText(title);
  };

  if (variant === "cta") {
    const scrollToHeroInput = () => {
      if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
      const el = document.getElementById(HERO_INPUT_ID);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    };

    return (
      <>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="ajrc-cta"
          onClick={scrollToHeroInput}
          style={{
            display: "inline-flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            backgroundColor: AMBER,
            color: CHARCOAL,
            fontFamily: DISPLAY,
            fontWeight: 800,
            fontSize: 18,
            padding: "16px 32px",
            borderRadius: 10,
            border: "none",
            cursor: "pointer",
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: 520,
            minHeight: 56,
            lineHeight: 1.1,
          }}
        >
          Get My Free Score
        </button>
        {showReassurance && (
          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: "column",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 4,
              marginTop: 16,
            }}
          >
            <p
              style={{
                fontFamily: SANS,
                fontSize: 12.5,
                lineHeight: 1.5,
                color: SOFT,
                opacity: 0.75,
                margin: 0,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              Your score and one task analyzed
              <span style={{ color: AMBER, margin: "0 6px" }}>·</span>
              About 60 seconds
            </p>
            <p
              style={{
                fontFamily: SANS,
                fontSize: 12.5,
                lineHeight: 1.5,
                color: SOFT,
                opacity: 0.75,
                margin: 0,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              No signup
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      className="ajrc-hero-form"
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        maxWidth: 520,
        margin: "0",
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
        gap: 8,
      }}
    >
      {!hideProgress && (
        <div className="hero-progress-bar" style={{ paddingTop: 8, paddingBottom: 12 }}>
          <JourneyProgress step={1} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="ajrc-hero-row">
        <div className="ajrc-hero-input-wrap" style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%" }}>
          <input
            id={HERO_INPUT_ID}
            type="text"
            value={title}
            onChange={onChange}
            placeholder="What's your job title?"
            aria-label="Your job title"
            autoComplete="off"
            autoCorrect="off"
            autoCapitalize="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            style={{
              width: "100%",
              padding: "18px 20px",
              fontFamily: SANS,
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: 500,
              color: CHARCOAL,
              backgroundColor: SOFT,
              border: "2px solid transparent",
              borderRadius: 10,
              outline: "none",
              boxSizing: "border-box",
              minHeight: 56,
            }}
          />

          {title.trim().length >= 2 && (
            <ul
              role="listbox"
              aria-label="Job title suggestions"
              style={{
                listStyle: "none",
                margin: 0,
                padding: 6,
                backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
                borderRadius: 10,
                maxHeight: 5 * 64 + 12 + 48,
                overflowY: "auto",
                boxShadow: "0 12px 32px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)",
                textAlign: "left",
              }}
            >
              {results.map((r) => {
                const sub = socMapReady ? socMapCache?.get(r.c) : undefined;
                return (
                  <li key={r.t + "|" + r.c}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => pickSuggestion(r)}
                      style={{
                        display: "block",
                        width: "100%",
                        minHeight: 56,
                        padding: "12px 14px",
                        background: "transparent",
                        border: "none",
                        borderRadius: 8,
                        textAlign: "left",
                        cursor: "pointer",
                        fontFamily: SANS,
                      }}
                    >
                      <span
                        style={{
                          display: "block",
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: 600,
                          color: CHARCOAL,
                          lineHeight: 1.25,
                        }}
                      >
                        {r.t}
                      </span>
                      {sub && (
                        <span
                          style={{
                            display: "block",
                            marginTop: 2,
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: 400,
                            color: "rgba(27,27,27,0.6)",
                            lineHeight: 1.3,
                          }}
                        >
                          {sub}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
              <li style={results.length > 0 ? { borderTop: "1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08)" } : undefined}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => goFreeText(title)}
                  className="ajrc-fallback-row"
                  style={{
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 10,
                    width: "100%",
                    minHeight: 48,
                    padding: "12px 14px",
                    background: "rgba(10, 107, 112, 0.06)",
                    border: "none",
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    textAlign: "left",
                    cursor: "pointer",
                    fontFamily: SANS,
                    color: TEAL,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: 15,
                  }}
                >
                  <Search size={16} color={TEAL} strokeWidth={2} />
                  Don't see your title? Use what I typed
                </button>
              </li>
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          type="submit"
          className="ajrc-cta ajrc-hero-submit"
          style={{
            display: "inline-flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            backgroundColor: AMBER,
            color: CHARCOAL,
            fontFamily: DISPLAY,
            fontWeight: 800,
            fontSize: 18,
            padding: "16px 32px",
            borderRadius: 10,
            border: "none",
            cursor: "pointer",
            width: "100%",
            minHeight: 56,
            lineHeight: 1.1,
          }}
        >
          Get My Free Score
        </button>
      </div>

      {showPrompt && (
        <p
          style={{
            fontFamily: SANS,
            fontSize: 14,
            color: AMBER,
            margin: 0,
            textAlign: "left",
          }}
        >
          Enter your job title to get started.
        </p>
      )}
      {showReassurance && (
        <div
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 4,
          }}
        >
          <p
            style={{
              fontFamily: SANS,
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: 400,
              color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)",
              margin: 0,
              textAlign: "center",
            }}
          >
            Your score and one task analyzed
            <span style={{ color: AMBER, margin: "0 6px" }}>·</span>
            About 60 seconds
          </p>
          <p
            style={{
              fontFamily: SANS,
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: 400,
              color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)",
              margin: 0,
              textAlign: "center",
            }}
          >
            No signup
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

7.2 -1.1 6.4 -1.1 5.6 C-1.1 4.7 -1.1 3.9 -1.1 3.1 C-1 1 -1 1 0 0 Z " transform="translate(76,105)"/></symbol>`;

export function JourneyProgress({ step }: { step?: number }) {
  const s = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Number(step) || 1));

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex justify-center select-none">
      <svg
        width={0}
        height={0}
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{ position: "absolute", width: 0, height: 0 }}
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: `<defs>${MARK_SYMBOL}</defs>` }}
      />
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 360 96"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`Step ${s} of 5`}
        className="w-full"
        style={{ maxWidth: 360, height: "auto" }}
      >
        {SEG.map((seg, i) => (
          <path
            key={`seg-${i}`}
            d={seg.d}
            fill="none"
            stroke={i + 1 < s ? LIT : DIM}
            strokeWidth={3}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeDasharray={seg.dash}
            style={{ transition: "stroke 280ms ease" }}
          />
        ))}
        {MARKS.map((p, i) => (
          <use
            key={`mark-${i}`}
            href="#cairnMark"
            x={p.x - SIZE / 2}
            y={p.y - SIZE / 2}
            width={SIZE}
            height={SIZE}
            fill={i < s ? LIT : DIM}
            style={{ transition: "fill 280ms ease" }}
          />
        ))}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

export default JourneyProgress;

import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

const isExternal = (to: string) => /^https?:\/\//.test(to) || to === "/";

const TEAL = "#0A6B70";
const TEAL_DEEP = "#08595D";
const SOFT = "#FAFAF8";
const AMBER = "#F4B400";
const DISPLAY = "'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
const CHARCOAL = "#1B1B1B";

// Add new links here to expose them in the nav dropdown.
export const NAV_LINKS: { label: string; to: string; external?: boolean }[] = [
  { label: "Home", to: "/" },
  { label: "Coaching", to: "/coaching" },
  { label: "How It Works", to: "/how-it-works" },
  { label: "Sample Report", to: "/sample-report" },
  { label: "Occupations", to: "/ai-job-risk" },
  { label: "FAQs", to: "/faqs" },
  { label: "Blog", to: "/blog" },
];


export function SiteHeader() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const firstItemRef = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement | null>(null);

  // Close on outside click / Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onPointer = (e: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) => {
      if (!containerRef.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setOpen(false);
        triggerRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointer);
    document.addEventListener("touchstart", onPointer);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    // Focus the first menu item for keyboard users.
    firstItemRef.current?.focus();
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onPointer);
      document.removeEventListener("touchstart", onPointer);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <header
      style={{
        backgroundColor: TEAL,
        borderBottom: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
        position: "relative",
        zIndex: 50,
      }}
    >
      <style>{`
        .ajrc-header-inner {
          max-width: min(96vw, 1600px);
          margin: 0 auto;
          padding: 4px clamp(16px, 2vw, 32px);
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: flex-start;
          position: relative;
        }
        .ajrc-nav-trigger {
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 12px;

        }

        .ajrc-nav-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid ${AMBER}; outline-offset: 2px; }
        .ajrc-nav-menu {
          position: absolute;
          top: 100%;
          left: clamp(16px, 2vw, 32px);
          margin-top: 8px;
          min-width: 200px;
          background-color: ${TEAL_DEEP};
          border: 1px solid rgba(244, 180, 0, 0.25);
          border-radius: 10px;

          padding: 8px;

        .ajrc-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid ${AMBER}; outline-offset: 2px; color: ${AMBER}; }
        .ajrc-nav-item[data-status="active"] { color: ${AMBER}; }
        .ajrc-nav-cta {
          display: block;
          font-family: ${DISPLAY};
          font-weight: 800;
          font-size: 16px;
          color: ${CHARCOAL};
          text-decoration: none;
          padding: 12px 12px;
          border-radius: 8px;
          background-color: ${AMBER};
          text-align: center;
          transition: background-color 150ms ease;
        }
        .ajrc-nav-cta:hover { background-color: #E0A400; }
        .ajrc-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid ${AMBER}; outline-offset: 2px; }

        .ajrc-desktop-only { display: none; }

        @media (min-width: 1024px) {
          .ajrc-header-inner {
            max-width: 1200px;
            padding-left: 48px;
            padding-right: 48px;
            justify-content: space-between;
            height: 52px;
          }
          .ajrc-nav-trigger,
          .ajrc-nav-menu { display: none !important; }
          .ajrc-desktop-only { display: flex; }

          .ajrc-desktop-logo {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            text-decoration: none;
          }
          .ajrc-desktop-logo img {
            height: 40px;
            width: auto;
            display: block;
          }
          .ajrc-desktop-logo span {
            font-family: ${DISPLAY};
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: #ffffff;
            letter-spacing: normal;
            line-height: 1;
          }

          .ajrc-desktop-nav {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 32px;
          }
          .ajrc-desktop-link {
            font-family: ${DISPLAY};
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: #ffffff;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 150ms ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
          }
          .ajrc-desktop-link:hover { color: ${AMBER}; }
          .ajrc-desktop-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid ${AMBER}; outline-offset: 2px; }
          .ajrc-desktop-link[data-status="active"] { color: ${AMBER}; }

          .ajrc-desktop-cta {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-family: ${DISPLAY};
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: ${CHARCOAL};
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 10px 16px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background-color: ${AMBER};
            transition: background-color 150ms ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
          }
          .ajrc-desktop-cta:hover { background-color: #E0A400; }
          .ajrc-desktop-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid ${AMBER}; outline-offset: 2px; }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className="ajrc-header-inner"
      >
        <button
          ref={triggerRef}
          type="button"
          className="ajrc-nav-trigger"
          aria-haspopup="menu"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls="ajrc-nav-menu"
          aria-label={open ? "Close navigation menu" : "Open navigation menu"}
          onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        >
          <img
            src="/icon-transparent.webp"
            alt="AI Job Risk Check"
            width={48}
            height={48}
            loading="eager"
            decoding="async"
            style={{ display: "block", background: "transparent" }}
          />
          <svg
            width="28"
            height="20"
            viewBox="0 0 28 20"
            fill="none"
            style={{ display: "block", flexShrink: 0 }}
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <rect y="0" width="28" height="3" rx="1.5" fill={SOFT} />
            <rect y="8.5" width="28" height="3" rx="1.5" fill={SOFT} />
            <rect y="17" width="28" height="3" rx="1.5" fill={SOFT} />
          </svg>
        </button>

        <a
          href="/"
          className="ajrc-desktop-only ajrc-desktop-logo"
          aria-label="AI Job Risk Check"
        >
          <img
            src="/logo-horizontal.png"
            alt="AI Job Risk Check. Your job. Your score. Your plan."
            height={40}
            loading="eager"
            decoding="async"
            style={{ display: "block", height: 40, width: "auto", background: "transparent" }}
          />
        </a>

        <nav
          className="ajrc-desktop-only ajrc-desktop-nav"
          aria-label="Primary"
        >
          {NAV_LINKS.filter(
            (l) => l.label !== "Home" && l.label !== "Sample Report"
          ).map((l) =>
            isExternal(l.to) ? (
              <a
                key={l.to}
                href={l.to}
                className="ajrc-desktop-link"
              >
                {l.label}
              </a>
            ) : (
              <Link
                key={l.to}
                to={l.to}
                className="ajrc-desktop-link"
                activeOptions={{ exact: true }}
              >
                {l.label}
              </Link>
            )
          )}
          <Link
            to="/assessment"
            className="ajrc-desktop-cta"
          >
            Get My Free Score
          </Link>
        </nav>

        {open && (
          <div
            id="ajrc-nav-menu"
            role="menu"
            aria-label="Primary"
            className="ajrc-nav-menu"
          >
            {NAV_LINKS.map((l, i) =>
              isExternal(l.to) ? (
                <a
                  key={l.to}
                  href={l.to}
                  role="menuitem"
                  className="ajrc-nav-item"
                  onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                >
                  {l.label}
                </a>
              ) : (
                <Link
                  key={l.to}
                  ref={i === 0 ? firstItemRef : undefined}
                  to={l.to}
                  role="menuitem"
                  className="ajrc-nav-item"
                  activeOptions={{ exact: true }}
                  onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                >
                  {l.label}
                </Link>
              )
            )}
            <Link
              to="/assessment"
              role="menuitem"
              className="ajrc-nav-cta"
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
            >
              Get My Free Score
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Footer } from "@/components/Footer";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "@/components/Breadcrumbs";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

const TEAL = "#0A6B70";
const AMBER = "#F4B400";
const SOFT = "#FAFAF8";
const CHARCOAL = "#1B1B1B";
const WHITE = "#FFFFFF";
const DISPLAY = "'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
const SANS = "Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";

export interface BlogPostProps {
  title: string;
  intro: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  path?: string;
  faqs?: { question: string; answer: string }[];
  breadcrumbs?: { name: string; path: string }[];
  beforeHeader?: ReactNode;
  titleFontSize?: string;
  headerBg?: string;
  bodyBg?: string;
}

export const bodyStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontFamily: SANS,
  fontWeight: 400,
  fontSize: "clamp(16px, 1.4vw, 18px)",
  lineHeight: 1.7,
  margin: 0,
  marginBottom: 24,
  color: CHARCOAL,
};

export const bodyStyleOnTeal: React.CSSProperties = {
  ...bodyStyle,
  color: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)",
};

export const linkStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  color: TEAL,
  textDecoration: "underline",
};

export function SectionHeading({
  children,
  variant = "light",
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  variant?: "light" | "teal";
}) {
  return (
    <h2
      className="cp-section-heading"
      style={{
        fontFamily: DISPLAY,
        fontWeight: 800,
        fontSize: "clamp(24px, 3vw, 30px)",
        lineHeight: 1.2,
        letterSpacing: -0.01,
        color: variant === "teal" ? WHITE : TEAL,
        display: "inline-block",
        borderBottom: `3px solid ${AMBER}`,
        paddingBottom: 6,
        margin: 0,
        marginTop: 56,
        marginBottom: 22,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </h2>
  );
}

export function FaqHeading({
  children,
  variant = "light",
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  variant?: "light" | "teal";
}) {
  return (
    <h3
      className="cp-question"
      style={{
        fontFamily: DISPLAY,
        fontWeight: 700,
        fontSize: "clamp(18px, 1.8vw, 20px)",
        color: variant === "teal" ? WHITE : CHARCOAL,
        margin: 0,
        marginTop: 28,
        marginBottom: 10,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </h3>
  );
}

export function CtaCard() {
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        backgroundColor: TEAL,
        borderRadius: 12,
        padding: "clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px)",
        margin: "8px 0 8px",
        textAlign: "center",
      }}
    >
      <p
        style={{
          fontFamily: SANS,
          fontWeight: 400,
          fontSize: "clamp(16px, 1.4vw, 18px)",
          lineHeight: 1.6,
          color: SOFT,
          margin: 0,
          marginBottom: 20,
        }}
      >
        Get your free AI Job Risk Score. Tell us your job title and how you
        actually spend your time, and we will show you which of your tasks are
        exposed today. Free. 60 seconds. No sign-up required.
      </p>
      <Link
        to="/"
        style={{
          display: "inline-flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          backgroundColor: AMBER,
          color: CHARCOAL,
          fontFamily: DISPLAY,
          fontWeight: 800,
          fontSize: 18,
          padding: "16px 32px",
          borderRadius: 10,
          textDecoration: "none",
          minHeight: 56,
          lineHeight: 1.1,
        }}
      >
        Get My Free Score
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ArticleImage({ src, alt, caption }: { src: string; alt: string; caption?: string }) {
  return (
    <figure style={{ margin: "32px 0" }}>
      <img
        src={src}
        alt={alt}
        loading="lazy"
        decoding="async"
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          height: "auto",
          borderRadius: 12,
          display: "block",
        }}
      />
      {caption && (
        <figcaption
          style={{
            fontFamily: SANS,
            fontWeight: 400,
            fontSize: 14,
            lineHeight: 1.5,
            color: "rgba(27,27,27,0.6)",
            textAlign: "center",
            marginTop: 10,
          }}
        >
          {caption}
        </figcaption>
      )}
    </figure>
  );
}

export default function BlogPost({
  title,
  intro,
  children,
  faqs,
  breadcrumbs,
  beforeHeader,
  titleFontSize = "clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 46px)",
  headerBg = TEAL,
  bodyBg = SOFT,
}: BlogPostProps) {
  const SITE = "https://aijobriskcheck.net";
  const jsonLd: unknown[] = [];

  if (faqs && faqs.length > 0) {
    jsonLd.push({
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "FAQPage",
      mainEntity: faqs.map((f) => ({
        "@type": "Question",
        name: f.question,
        acceptedAnswer: {
          "@type": "Answer",
          text: f.answer,
        },
      })),
    });
  }

  if (breadcrumbs && breadcrumbs.length > 0) {
    jsonLd.push({
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
      itemListElement: breadcrumbs.map((b, i) => ({
        "@type": "ListItem",
        position: i + 1,
        name: b.name,
        item: SITE + b.path,
      })),
    });
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        minHeight: "100vh",
        backgroundColor: SOFT,
        fontFamily: SANS,
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
      }}
    >
      {jsonLd.length > 0 && (
        <script
          type="application/ld+json"
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd) }}
        />
      )}
      {beforeHeader}
      <header
        className="cp-section"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: headerBg,
          padding: "clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px) 16px clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px)",
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ maxWidth: 720, margin: "0 auto" }}>
          {breadcrumbs && breadcrumbs.length > 0 && (
            <Breadcrumbs items={breadcrumbs} variant="dark" />
          )}
          <div
            style={{
              width: 48,
              height: 4,
              backgroundColor: AMBER,
              borderRadius: 2,
              marginBottom: 20,
            }}
          />
          <h1
            className="cp-section-heading"
            style={{
              fontFamily: DISPLAY,
              fontWeight: 800,
              fontSize: titleFontSize,
              lineHeight: 1.12,
              letterSpacing: -0.01,
              color: SOFT,
              margin: 0,
              marginBottom: 20,
            }}
          >
            {title}
          </h1>
          <p
            className="cp-body"
            style={{
              fontFamily: SANS,
              fontWeight: 400,
              fontSize: "clamp(17px, 1.6vw, 19px)",
              lineHeight: 1.6,
              margin: 0,
              color: "rgba(250, 250, 248, 0.9)",
            }}
          >
            {intro}
          </p>
        </div>
      </header>


      <main
        className="cp-section"
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          padding: "clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px) 16px clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px)",
          backgroundColor: bodyBg,
        }}
      >
        <article
          style={{
            maxWidth: 720,
            margin: "0 auto",
            color: CHARCOAL,
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </article>
      </main>

      <Footer />
    </div>
  );
}

===FILE:src/components/LoadingState.tsx===
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import BugWalker from "./BugWalker";

const TEAL = "#0A6B70";

export const LOADING_PHRASES: { text: string; start: number }[] = [
  { text: "Mapping your responsibilities", start: 0 },
  { text: "Comparing your tasks to current AI capabilities", start: 5000 },
  { text: "Evaluating automation exposure", start: 10000 },
  { text: "Identifying high-impact workflow patterns", start: 15000 },
  { text: "Comparing your role against similar occupations", start: 20000 },
  { text: "Analyzing long-term AI disruption trends", start: 25000 },
  { text: "Estimating task-level vulnerability", start: 30000 },
];

const PHRASE_DURATIONS: number[] = LOADING_PHRASES.map((p, i) => {
  const next = LOADING_PHRASES[i + 1];
  return next ? next.start - p.start : 5000;
});

export function LoadingState({
  exiting = false,
  fillParent = false,
  phrases = LOADING_PHRASES,
}: {
  exiting?: boolean;
  fillParent?: boolean;
  phrases?: { text: string; start: number }[];
}) {
  const [phraseIndex, setPhraseIndex] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const durations = phrases.map((p, i) => {
      const next = phrases[i + 1];
      return next ? next.start - p.start : 5000;
    });
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    let current = 0;
    const schedule = () => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        current = (current + 1) % phrases.length;
        setPhraseIndex(current);
        schedule();
      }, durations[current]);
    };
    schedule();
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [phrases]);

  

  return (
    <div
      className={exiting ? "ajrc-loading-exit" : ""}
      style={{
        position: "relative",
        minHeight: fillParent ? "100%" : "100vh",
        height: fillParent ? "100%" : undefined,
        width: "100%",
        overflow: "hidden",
        background: TEAL,
      }}
    >
      <style>{`
        @keyframes ajrc-phrase-in {
          0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); }
          100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        .ajrc-phrase {
          display: block;
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 100%;
          text-align: center;
          white-space: normal;
          overflow-wrap: break-word;
          word-break: normal;
          will-change: transform, opacity;
          animation: ajrc-phrase-in 800ms ease-out both;
        }
        .ajrc-dots { display: inline; white-space: nowrap; }
        .ajrc-dot {
          display: inline-block;
          opacity: 0;
          animation: ajrc-dot-cycle 1500ms linear infinite;
        }
        .ajrc-dot + .ajrc-dot { margin-left: 0.08em; }
        .ajrc-dot-1 { animation-delay: 0ms; }
        .ajrc-dot-2 { animation-delay: 300ms; }
        .ajrc-dot-3 { animation-delay: 600ms; }
        @keyframes ajrc-dot-cycle {
          0%     { opacity: 0; }
          20%    { opacity: 1; }
          86.66% { opacity: 1; }
          100%   { opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes ajrc-loading-fade-out { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0; } }
        .ajrc-loading-exit { animation: ajrc-loading-fade-out 400ms ease-out forwards; }
      `}</style>

      <div
        style={{
          position: "absolute",
          inset: 0,
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          gap: "clamp(40px, 9vw, 120px)",
          padding: "0 24px",
        }}
      >
        <img
          src="/logo-stacked-nobug.png"
          alt="AI Job Risk Check — Your job. Your score. Your plan."
          data-bug-dock
          style={{
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: "min(900px, 92vw)",
            height: "auto",
            objectFit: "contain",
            display: "block",
          }}
        />

        <div
          data-bug-avoid
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: "clamp(16px, 2vw, 24px)",
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: 640,
            minWidth: 0,
          }}
        >
          <div
            role="status"
            aria-live="polite"
            style={{
              position: "relative",
              width: "100%",
              maxWidth: "100%",
              minWidth: 0,
              fontFamily: '"Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif',
              fontWeight: 800,
              fontSize: "clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem)",

          >

                <span key={i}>

              ))}
              <span className="ajrc-dots" aria-hidden="true">
                <span className="ajrc-dot ajrc-dot-1">.</span>
                <span className="ajrc-dot ajrc-dot-2">.</span>
                <span className="ajrc-dot ajrc-dot-3">.</span>

          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontWeight: 400,
              fontSize: "clamp(0.95rem, 1.6vw, 1.5rem)",
              color: "rgba(250, 250, 248, 0.75)",
              letterSpacing: "0.02em",
              textAlign: "center",
            }}
          >
            This may take up to 45 seconds.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <BugWalker />
    </div>
  );
}

import { bodyStyleOnTeal, SectionHeading, FaqHeading } from "@/components/BlogPost";

export const coachingFaqs = [
  {
    question: "What exactly is the coaching?",
    answer:
      "Short, personal text messages built around your report and your goals. We help you turn the plan into one doable step at a time, and we adjust as you go.",
  },
  {
    question: "Do I have to download an app?",
    answer: "No. Everything happens over text. No app, no login, no password.",
  },
  {
    question: "How often will you text me?",
    answer:
      "Only when it helps. A few messages at the moments that matter, never a constant stream. When one more text would be too many, we stop.",
  },
  {
    question: "Will I be charged automatically?",
    answer:
      "Not from your purchase. The $29.99 never renews. Continuing coaching is $12.99 a month and starts only when you use the link we send. Once you start it, it renews each month until you cancel.",
  },
  {
    question: "What if I get busy, or it is not working?",
    answer:
      "Then we change our approach, not your life. The coaching flexes lighter or closer to fit where you are.",
  },
  {
    question: "Do I need the coaching, or is the report enough?",
    answer:
      "The report shows you where you stand and what to do. The coaching is what makes sure it happens. You can start with the report alone. Most people find the plan is far easier to follow with someone in their corner.",
  },
];

const SANS = "Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";

export function CoachingBodyEnd() {

}
