import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { supabase, invokeFunction } from "@/lib/supabase";
import { buildPageHead } from "@/lib/seo";
import { track } from "@/lib/analytics";
import { JourneyProgress } from "@/components/JourneyProgress";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/assessment")({
  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
    title: typeof search.title === "string" ? search.title : undefined,
    soc: typeof search.soc === "string" ? search.soc : undefined,
    occ: typeof search.occ === "string" ? search.occ : undefined,
    conf: typeof search.conf === "string" ? search.conf : undefined,
  }),
  head: () =>
    buildPageHead({
      path: "/assessment",
      title: "Start Your Free AI Job Risk Assessment | AI Job Risk Check",
      description:
        "Tell us your job and how you spend your time. We map your role to U.S. Department of Labor data and score your AI exposure task by task. Free, no signup.",
      extraMeta: [{ name: "robots", content: "noindex, follow" }],
    }),
  component: Assessment,
});


const TEAL = "#0A6B70";
const AMBER = "#F4B400";
const CHARCOAL = "#1B1B1B";
const SOFT = "#FAFAF8";
const RED = "#E53935";
const DIVIDER = "#ECEAE3";

type MatchResult = {
  soc_code: string;
  title: string;
  confidence: number;
  clarifying_questions?: string[];
};

type Candidate = {
  soc_code: string;
  title: string;
  confidence: number;
  reason?: string;
};

type TaskRow = { id: number; task_id: string; task_text: string };
type RatingEntry = { task_id: number; rating: number };

type Step = 1 | 2 | 3;

function Assessment() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { title: titleFromSearch, soc: socFromSearch, occ: occFromSearch, conf: confFromSearch } = Route.useSearch();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>(1);
  const [jobTitle, setJobTitle] = useState(titleFromSearch ?? "");
  const [jobDescription, setJobDescription] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [match, setMatch] = useState<MatchResult | null>(null);
  const [candidates, setCandidates] = useState<Candidate[] | null>(null);
  const [ratings, setRatings] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [interacted, setInteracted] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<TaskRow[] | null>(null);
  const [assessmentId, setAssessmentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [roleLevel, setRoleLevel] = useState<"ic" | "manager" | null>(null);
  const [tasksDone, setTasksDone] = useState(false);
  const [customEntry, setCustomEntry] = useState<{ text: string; weight: number } | null>(null);
  const sessionIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  if (sessionIdRef.current === null && typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto) {
    sessionIdRef.current = crypto.randomUUID();
  }

  const resetTaskState = () => {
    setTasks(null);
    setRatings({});
    setInteracted({});
    setTasksDone(false);
    setCustomEntry(null);
  };

  // Confident pick: if soc+occ provided in URL, skip Step 1 and jump straight to tasks.
  const autoSkipRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoSkipRef.current) return;
    if (!titleFromSearch || !socFromSearch || !occFromSearch) return;
    autoSkipRef.current = true;
    const confidence = (() => {
      const n = confFromSearch ? Number(confFromSearch) : 1;
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 1;
      return n > 1 ? n / 100 : n;
    })();
    track("Occupation Matched", { occupation_title: occFromSearch, source: "typeahead" });
    resetTaskState();
    setMatch({ soc_code: socFromSearch, title: occFromSearch, confidence });
    (async () => {
      try {
        const sid = sessionIdRef.current ?? crypto.randomUUID();
        sessionIdRef.current = sid;
        const { data, error: insErr } = await supabase.rpc("app_create_assessment", {
          p_session_id: sid,
          p_job_title_input: titleFromSearch,
          p_job_description: "",
          p_matched_soc_code: socFromSearch,
          p_matched_title: occFromSearch,
          p_match_confidence: confidence,
        });
        if (insErr) throw insErr;
        setAssessmentId(data as string);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("create assessment failed (typeahead)", err);
      }
    })();
    setStep(2);
  }, [titleFromSearch, socFromSearch, occFromSearch, confFromSearch]);


  // If user lands here with no title and no occupation, send them home.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!titleFromSearch && !socFromSearch) {
      navigate({ to: "/" });
    }
  }, [titleFromSearch, socFromSearch, navigate]);

  const handleSelectCandidate = async (c: Candidate) => {
    track("Occupation Matched", { occupation_title: c.title, source: "fallback" });
    resetTaskState();
    setMatch({ soc_code: c.soc_code, title: c.title, confidence: 1 });
    setError(null);
    try {
      const sid = sessionIdRef.current ?? crypto.randomUUID();
      sessionIdRef.current = sid;
      const { data, error: insErr } = await supabase.rpc("app_create_assessment", {
        p_session_id: sid,
        p_job_title_input: jobTitle,
        p_job_description: jobDescription,
        p_matched_soc_code: c.soc_code,
        p_matched_title: c.title,
        p_match_confidence: 1,
      });
      if (insErr) throw insErr;
      setAssessmentId(data as string);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("create assessment failed", err);
    }
    setStep(2);
  };



  return (
    <div
      style={{
        backgroundColor: TEAL,
        minHeight: "100vh",
        padding: "40px 20px",
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
        alignItems: "center",
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: 700, paddingBottom: 16 }}>
        <JourneyProgress
          step={
            step === 3 ? 3 : step === 2 ? (tasksDone ? 3 : 2) : 1
          }
        />
      </div>

      {step === 1 && (
        <FallbackPicker
          initialTitle={jobTitle}
          onPick={handleSelectCandidate}
          onPhraseChange={setJobDescription}
        />
      )}


      {step === 2 && match && !tasksDone && (
        <Step2Tasks
          match={match}
          tasks={tasks}
          setTasks={setTasks}
          ratings={ratings}
          setRatings={setRatings}
          interacted={interacted}
          setInteracted={setInteracted}
          customEntry={customEntry}
          setCustomEntry={setCustomEntry}
          onBack={() => {
            resetTaskState();
            setStep(1);
          }}
          onTasksComplete={() => setTasksDone(true)}
        />

      )}

      {step === 2 && match && tasksDone && (
        <SeniorityStep
          match={match}
          onBack={() => setTasksDone(false)}
          onSelect={async (lvl) => {
            setRoleLevel(lvl);
            if (!assessmentId || !tasks) {
              return;
            }
            try {
              const { error: rlErr } = await supabase.rpc("app_set_role_level", { p_id: assessmentId, p_role_level: lvl });
              if (rlErr) throw rlErr;
            } catch (err) {
              console.error("update role_level failed", err);
            }
            try {
              const rows = tasks.map((t, i) => ({
                assessment_id: assessmentId,
                task_id: t.id,
                rating: ratings[`${t.id}-${i}`] ?? 0,
              }));
              const { error: ratingsErr } = await supabase
                .from("assessment_task_ratings")
                .insert(rows);
              if (ratingsErr) throw ratingsErr;
              const scorePromise = supabase.functions.invoke("calculate-score", {
                body: { assessment_id: assessmentId },
              });
              const customPromise = customEntry
                ? supabase.functions.invoke("analyze-custom-task", {
                    body: {
                      task_text: customEntry.text,
                      rating: customEntry.weight,
                      session_id: sessionIdRef.current,
                    },
                  })
                : Promise.resolve(null);
              const [scoreRes, customRes] = await Promise.all([scorePromise, customPromise]);
              if (customRes && (customRes as { error?: unknown }).error) {
                console.error("analyze-custom-task failed", (customRes as { error?: unknown }).error);
              }
              if (scoreRes.error) throw scoreRes.error;
              if (scoreRes.data?.error) throw new Error(scoreRes.data.error);
            } catch (err) {
              console.error("scoring after seniority failed", err);
            }
            navigate({ to: "/calculating", search: { id: assessmentId } });
          }}
        />
      )}


      

      {step === 3 && match && (
        <Step3Calculating
          match={match}
          ratingsCount={Object.keys(ratings).length}
          onBack={() => setStep(2)}
        />
      )}

      <style>{`
        @keyframes ajrc-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        @keyframes ajrc-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; } 50% { opacity: 0.85; } }
        @media (min-width: 600px) {
          .match-actions { flex-direction: row !important; }
          .step2-actions { flex-direction: row !important; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

function FallbackPicker({
  initialTitle,
  onPick,
  onPhraseChange,
}: {
  initialTitle: string;
  onPick: (c: Candidate) => void;
  onPhraseChange: (s: string) => void;
}) {
  type Phase = "loading" | "cards" | "needsPhrase" | "phraseLoading";
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("loading");
  const [candidates, setCandidates] = useState<Candidate[]>([]);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"title_only" | "ranked">("title_only");
  const [phrase, setPhrase] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialTitle || initialTitle.trim().length < 2) {
      setPhase("needsPhrase");
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { data, error: fnErr } = await invokeFunction("match-occupation", { job_title: initialTitle });
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (fnErr || data?.error) {
          setPhase("needsPhrase");
          return;
        }
        const list = Array.isArray(data?.candidates) ? (data.candidates as Candidate[]) : [];
        if (list.length === 0) {
          setPhase("needsPhrase");
          return;
        }
        setCandidates(list);
        setMode("title_only");
        setPhase("cards");
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setPhase("needsPhrase");
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [initialTitle]);

  const phraseWordCount = phrase.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  const phraseValid = phraseWordCount >= 2;

  const submitPhrase = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!phraseValid || phase === "phraseLoading") return;
    setPhase("phraseLoading");
    setError(null);
    const p = phrase.trim();
    onPhraseChange(p);
    try {
      const { data, error: fnErr } = await invokeFunction("match-occupation", { job_title: initialTitle, job_description: p });
      if (fnErr) throw fnErr;
      if (data?.error) {
        throw new Error(String(data.error));
      }
      const list = Array.isArray(data?.candidates) ? (data.candidates as Candidate[]) : [];
      if (list.length === 0) {
        setError("No matches found. Try different words.");
        setPhase("needsPhrase");
        return;
      }
      setCandidates(list);
      setMode("ranked");
      setPhase("cards");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("match-occupation failed:", err);
      setError("Something went wrong matching your role. Please try again.");
      setPhase("needsPhrase");
    }
  };

  const cardBtnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: "block",
    width: "100%",
    textAlign: "left",
    padding: "18px 20px",
    minHeight: 72,
    backgroundColor: "#fff",
    border: `2px solid ${DIVIDER}`,
    borderRadius: 14,
    cursor: "pointer",
    fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
    transition: "border-color 120ms ease, transform 80ms ease",
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        maxWidth: 600,
        backgroundColor: "#fff",
        borderRadius: 20,
        padding: "32px 24px",
        boxShadow: "0 20px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
      }}
    >
      <style>{`
        .ajrc-cand-card:active { transform: scale(0.99); border-color: ${TEAL} !important; }
        .ajrc-cand-card:hover { border-color: ${TEAL}; }
        .ajrc-quiet-btn:active { background-color: rgba(10,107,112,0.08) !important; }
      `}</style>

      
      <h1
        className="font-display font-extrabold"
        style={{ color: CHARCOAL, fontSize: "clamp(24px, 4vw, 32px)", marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 1.2 }}
      >
        Which of these is closest to your work?
      </h1>
      {initialTitle && (
        <p
          style={{
            color: "#666",
            fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
            fontSize: 14,
            marginTop: 8,
          }}
        >
          You typed: <span style={{ color: CHARCOAL, fontWeight: 600 }}>{initialTitle}</span>
        </p>
      )}

      {(phase === "loading" || phase === "phraseLoading") && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12 }}>
          {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                height: 72,
                borderRadius: 14,
                background: "linear-gradient(90deg, #f1efe8, #faf8f2, #f1efe8)",
                backgroundSize: "200% 100%",
                animation: "ajrc-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite",
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === "cards" && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12 }}>
          {candidates.map((c, idx) => (
            <button
              key={`${c.soc_code}-${idx}`}
              type="button"
              className="ajrc-cand-card"
              onClick={() => onPick(c)}
              style={cardBtnStyle}
            >
              <span
                className="font-display font-extrabold"
                style={{ display: "block", color: TEAL, fontSize: 18, lineHeight: 1.25 }}
              >
                {c.title}
              </span>
              {mode === "ranked" && c.reason && (
                <span
                  style={{
                    display: "block",
                    marginTop: 6,
                    color: "#666",
                    fontSize: 13,
                    lineHeight: 1.4,
                  }}
                >
                  {c.reason}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}

          <button
            type="button"
            className="ajrc-quiet-btn"
            onClick={() => {
              setError(null);
              setPhase("needsPhrase");
            }}
            style={{
              marginTop: 4,
              minHeight: 48,
              width: "100%",
              background: "transparent",
              border: "none",
              color: TEAL,
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: 15,
              cursor: "pointer",
              borderRadius: 10,
            }}
          >
            None of these fit
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === "needsPhrase" && (
        <form onSubmit={submitPhrase} style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
          <label htmlFor="ajrc-phrase" style={labelStyle}>
            In a few words, what do you do?
          </label>
          <input
            id="ajrc-phrase"
            type="text"
            value={phrase}
            onChange={(e) => setPhrase(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. write marketing emails and run campaigns"
            autoFocus
            style={inputStyle}
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={!phraseValid}
            className="font-display font-extrabold"
            style={{
              marginTop: 16,
              width: "100%",
              height: 56,
              borderRadius: 12,
              backgroundColor: AMBER,
              color: CHARCOAL,
              fontSize: 18,
              border: "none",
              cursor: phraseValid ? "pointer" : "not-allowed",
              opacity: phraseValid ? 1 : 0.5,
            }}
          >
            Find My Match
          </button>
          {error && (
            <p
              style={{
                color: RED,
                fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                fontWeight: 500,
                fontSize: 14,
                marginTop: 14,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



function Step2Tasks({
  match,
  tasks,
  setTasks,
  ratings,
  setRatings,
  interacted,
  setInteracted,
  onBack,
  onTasksComplete,
  setCustomEntry,
}: {
  match: MatchResult;
  tasks: TaskRow[] | null;
  setTasks: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<TaskRow[] | null>>;
  ratings: Record<string, number>;
  setRatings: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Record<string, number>>>;
  interacted: Record<string, boolean>;
  setInteracted: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Record<string, boolean>>>;
  customEntry: { text: string; weight: number } | null;
  setCustomEntry: (entry: { text: string; weight: number } | null) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onTasksComplete: () => void;
}) {
  const [loadErr, setLoadErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fetching, setFetching] = useState(tasks === null);
  const [customText, setCustomText] = useState("");
  const [customRating, setCustomRating] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tasks !== null) {
      setFetching(false);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      setFetching(true);
      setLoadErr(null);
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("onet_tasks")
        .select("id, task_id, task_text, importance")
        .eq("soc_code", match.soc_code)
        .order("importance", { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
        .limit(5);
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (error) {
        console.error("onet_tasks load failed:", error);
        setLoadErr("We couldn't load your tasks. Please refresh, and contact support if it continues.");
        setTasks([]);
      } else {
        setTasks((data ?? []) as TaskRow[]);
      }
      setFetching(false);
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [match.soc_code, tasks, setTasks]);

  const total = tasks?.length ?? 0;
  const rated = total;
  const allRated = total > 0;

  const trimmedCustom = customText.trim();
  const hasCustomText = trimmedCustom.length > 0;
  const customReady = !hasCustomText || customRating !== null;
  const canContinue = allRated && customReady;

  const [submitErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!tasks || !canContinue) return;
    if (hasCustomText && customRating !== null) {
      setCustomEntry({ text: trimmedCustom.slice(0, 600), weight: customRating });
    } else {
      setCustomEntry(null);
    }
    onTasksComplete();
  };
  const submitting = false;

  const showEmpty = !fetching && tasks && tasks.length === 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (showEmpty) {
      onBack();
    }
  }, [showEmpty, onBack]);


  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        maxWidth: 700,
        backgroundColor: "#fff",
        borderRadius: 20,
        padding: "40px 32px",
        boxShadow: "0 20px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
      }}
    >
      

      <h2
        className="font-display font-extrabold"
        style={{ color: CHARCOAL, fontSize: "clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 34px)", marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 1.2 }}
      >
        How do you actually spend your time?
      </h2>
      {!fetching && tasks && tasks.length > 0 && (
        <p
          style={{
            color: CHARCOAL,
            fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
            fontWeight: 500,
            fontSize: 16,
            lineHeight: 1.5,
            marginTop: 20,
          }}
        >
          When considering an <strong>average workweek</strong>, how much of your time do you spend on the following:
        </p>
      )}

      <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        {fetching && <TasksSkeleton />}

        {showEmpty && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <p
              style={{
                color: RED,
                fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                fontWeight: 500,
                fontSize: 15,
                lineHeight: 1.5,
              }}
            >
              We couldn't load tasks for this occupation. Please go back and try a different match.
            </p>
            {loadErr && (
              <p style={{ color: "#999", fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", fontSize: 12, marginTop: 6 }}>
                {loadErr}
              </p>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onBack}
              className="font-display font-extrabold"
              style={{
                marginTop: 16,
                height: 48,
                padding: "0 24px",
                borderRadius: 12,
                backgroundColor: "transparent",
                color: TEAL,
                border: `2px solid ${TEAL}`,
                fontSize: 15,
                cursor: "pointer",
              }}
            >
              Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {!fetching && tasks && tasks.length > 0 && (
          <div>
            {tasks.map((t, i) => {
              const key = `${t.id}-${i}`;
              const value = ratings[key] ?? 0;
              return (
                <div
                  key={key}
                  style={{
                    display: "flex",
                    flexDirection: "column",
                    gap: 12,
                    padding: "16px 0",
                    borderTop: i === 0 ? "none" : `1px solid ${DIVIDER}`,
                  }}
                  className="task-row"
                >
                  <div
                    style={{
                      color: CHARCOAL,
                      fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                      fontWeight: 400,
                      fontSize: 15,
                      lineHeight: 1.5,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t.task_text}
                  </div>
                  <TaskScale
                    value={value}
                    onChange={(v) => {
                      setRatings((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: v }));
                      setInteracted((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: true }));
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })}

            <p
              style={{
                marginTop: 20,
                color: "#666",
                fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                fontSize: 13,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {rated} of 5 tasks rated
            </p>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 24, paddingTop: 20, borderTop: `1px solid ${DIVIDER}` }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  color: CHARCOAL,
                  fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                  fontWeight: 500,
                  fontSize: 15,
                  lineHeight: 1.5,
                  marginBottom: 10,
                }}
              >
                Is there something you do that we left off of the list? If so, please enter it here.
              </div>
              <textarea
                value={customText}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const next = e.target.value.slice(0, 600);
                  setCustomText(next);
                  if (next.trim().length === 0) setCustomRating(null);
                }}
                placeholder="Describe one task you do"
                rows={3}
                maxLength={600}
                autoComplete="off"
                autoCorrect="off"
                autoCapitalize="off"
                spellCheck={false}
                style={{
                  width: "100%",
                  padding: "12px 14px",
                  fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                  fontSize: 16,
                  color: CHARCOAL,
                  border: "1px solid #E5E2DB",
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  outline: "none",
                  background: "#fff",
                  resize: "vertical",
                  minHeight: 80,
                }}
              />
              <div
                style={{
                  textAlign: "right",
                  color: "#888",
                  fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                  fontSize: 12,
                  marginTop: 4,
                }}
              >
                {customText.length}/600
              </div>
              {hasCustomText && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      color: CHARCOAL,
                      fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                      fontWeight: 500,
                      fontSize: 15,
                      marginBottom: 10,
                    }}
                  >
                    How much of your time does this take?
                  </div>
                  <TaskScale
                    value={customRating ?? -1}
                    onChange={(v) => setCustomRating(v)}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>


            <div
              className="step2-actions"
              style={{ marginTop: 16, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10 }}
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onBack}
                className="font-display font-extrabold"
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  height: 52,
                  borderRadius: 12,
                  backgroundColor: "transparent",
                  color: TEAL,
                  border: `2px solid ${TEAL}`,
                  fontSize: 16,
                  cursor: "pointer",
                }}
              >
                Back
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSubmit}
                disabled={!canContinue || submitting}
                className="font-display font-extrabold"
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  height: 52,
                  borderRadius: 12,
                  backgroundColor: AMBER,
                  color: CHARCOAL,
                  border: "none",
                  fontSize: 16,
                  cursor: canContinue && !submitting ? "pointer" : "not-allowed",
                  opacity: canContinue && !submitting ? 1 : 0.6,
                }}
              >
                {submitting ? "Calculating your score…" : "Continue"}
              </button>
            </div>
            {submitErr && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: 14, textAlign: "center" }}>
                <p
                  style={{
                    color: RED,
                    fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                    fontWeight: 500,
                    fontSize: 14,
                  }}
                >
                  {submitErr}
                </p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleSubmit}
                  className="font-display font-extrabold"
                  style={{
                    marginTop: 10,
                    height: 44,
                    padding: "0 20px",
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    backgroundColor: "transparent",
                    color: TEAL,
                    border: `2px solid ${TEAL}`,
                    fontSize: 14,
                    cursor: "pointer",
                  }}
                >
                  Try again
                </button>

function TaskScale({ value, onChange }: { value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void }) {

        return (
          <button

}

function TaskSlider({
  value,
  touched,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: number | undefined;
  touched: boolean;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
}) {
  const displayValue = typeof value === "number" ? value : 0;
  const pct = displayValue;
  // Interpolate thumb color: teal (#0A6B70) at 0% → near-white (#FAFAF8) at 50% → amber (#F4B400) at 100%
  const t = pct / 100;
  const lerp = (a: number, b: number, u: number) => Math.round(a + (b - a) * u);
  const mix = (from: [number, number, number], to: [number, number, number], u: number) => [
    lerp(from[0], to[0], u),
    lerp(from[1], to[1], u),
    lerp(from[2], to[2], u),
  ] as [number, number, number];
  const TEAL_RGB: [number, number, number] = [0x0A, 0x6B, 0x70];
  const MID_RGB: [number, number, number] = [0xFA, 0xFA, 0xF8];
  const AMBER_RGB: [number, number, number] = [0xF4, 0xB4, 0x00];
  const [thumbR, thumbG, thumbB] = t <= 0.5 ? mix(TEAL_RGB, MID_RGB, t / 0.5) : mix(MID_RGB, AMBER_RGB, (t - 0.5) / 0.5);
  const thumbColor = `rgb(${thumbR}, ${thumbG}, ${thumbB})`;
  const ticks = [0, 25, 50, 75, 100];
  const minorTicks = Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, i) => i * 5).filter((n) => n % 25 !== 0);
  return (
    <div style={{ width: "100%" }}>
      <div
        style={{
          position: "relative",
          height: 20,
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          cursor: "pointer",
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            height: 6,
            borderRadius: 999,
            backgroundColor: "#E5E2DB",
          }}
        />
        {touched && (
          <div
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: 0,
              width: `${pct}%`,
              height: 6,
              borderRadius: 999,
              backgroundColor: TEAL,
            }}
          />
        )}
        <div
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            left: `calc(${pct}% - 10px)`,
            width: 20,
            height: 20,
            borderRadius: "50%",
            backgroundColor: thumbColor,
            border: `1px solid ${CHARCOAL}`,
            pointerEvents: "none",
          }}
        />
        <input
          type="range"
          min={0}
          max={100}
          step={1}
          value={displayValue}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            width: "100%",
            opacity: 0,
            height: 20,
            margin: 0,
            cursor: "pointer",
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <div
        style={{
          position: "relative",
          marginTop: 8,
          height: 6,
        }}
      >
        {minorTicks.map((tk) => (
          <div
            key={`mtick-${tk}`}
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: `${tk}%`,
              transform: "translateX(-50%)",
              width: 1,
              height: 3,
              backgroundColor: CHARCOAL,
              opacity: 0.4,
            }}
          />
        ))}
        {ticks.map((tk) => (
          <div
            key={`tick-${tk}`}
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: `${tk}%`,
              transform: "translateX(-50%)",
              width: 1,
              height: 6,
              backgroundColor: CHARCOAL,
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div
        style={{
          position: "relative",
          marginTop: 4,
          height: 18,
          color: CHARCOAL,
          fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
          fontWeight: 400,
          fontSize: 12,
        }}
      >
        {ticks.map((tk) => (
          <span
            key={`label-${tk}`}
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: `${tk}%`,
              transform:
                tk === 0
                  ? "translateX(0)"
                  : tk === 100
                  ? "translateX(-100%)"
                  : "translateX(-50%)",
            }}
          >
            {tk}%
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const pillSkeletonStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  height: 38,
  width: 96,
  borderRadius: 999,
  backgroundColor: "#EEEBE3",
  animation: "ajrc-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite",
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

};

function StepIndicator({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {

function SeniorityStep({
  match,
  onSelect,
  onBack,
}: {
  match: MatchResult;
  onSelect: (level: "ic" | "manager") => void | Promise<void>;
  onBack?: () => void;
}) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<"ic" | "manager" | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const timeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleSelect = async (value: "ic" | "manager") => {
    if (submitting) return;
    setSelected(value);
    setSubmitting(true);

    // Safety net: re-enable if navigation never happens within 10 s
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }, 10000);

    try {
      await Promise.resolve(onSelect(value));
    } catch {
      // onSelect threw — re-enable so user can retry
    }
    setSubmitting(false);
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
      timeoutRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  const options: Array<{ value: "ic" | "manager"; label: string; helper: string }> = [
    { value: "ic", label: "I do this work myself", helper: "I'm hands-on with these tasks." },
    { value: "manager", label: "I manage people who do it", helper: "I oversee others who do this work." },
  ];
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        maxWidth: 600,
        backgroundColor: "#fff",
        borderRadius: 20,
        padding: "40px 32px",
        boxShadow: "0 20px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
      }}
    >
      
      <div
        style={{
          marginTop: 10,
          color: TEAL,
          fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
          fontWeight: 600,
          fontSize: 14,
        }}
      >
        {match.title}
      </div>
      <h1
        className="font-display font-extrabold"
        style={{ color: CHARCOAL, fontSize: "clamp(24px, 4vw, 32px)", marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 1.25 }}
      >
        Do you mostly do this work, or manage people who do it?
      </h1>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 14 }}>
        {options.map((opt) => {
          const isSelected = selected === opt.value;
          const dimmed = submitting && !isSelected;
          return (
            <button
              key={opt.value}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSelect(opt.value)}
              disabled={submitting}
              className="ajrc-seniority-btn"
              style={{
                width: "100%",
                minHeight: 72,
                padding: "16px 20px",
                borderRadius: 14,
                border: `2px solid ${isSelected ? TEAL : TEAL}`,
                backgroundColor: isSelected ? TEAL : "#fff",
                color: isSelected ? "#fff" : CHARCOAL,
                textAlign: "left",
                cursor: submitting ? "not-allowed" : "pointer",
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                gap: 4,
                transition: "transform 0.05s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease",
                opacity: dimmed ? 0.5 : 1,
              }}
            >
              <span
                className="font-display font-extrabold"
                style={{ color: isSelected ? "#fff" : TEAL, fontSize: 18, lineHeight: 1.2 }}
              >
                {opt.label}
              </span>
              <span
                style={{
                  color: isSelected ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)" : "#555",
                  fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                  fontSize: 14,
                  lineHeight: 1.4,
                }}
              >
                {opt.helper}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {submitting && (
        <p
          style={{
            marginTop: 16,
            textAlign: "center",
            color: TEAL,
            fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
            fontWeight: 500,
            fontSize: 14,
          }}
        >
          Calculating your score…
        </p>
      )}

      {onBack && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBack}
          disabled={submitting}
          className="font-display font-extrabold"
          style={{
            marginTop: 20,
            height: 48,
            padding: "0 24px",
            borderRadius: 12,
            backgroundColor: "transparent",
            color: TEAL,
            border: `2px solid ${TEAL}`,
            fontSize: 15,
            cursor: submitting ? "not-allowed" : "pointer",
            opacity: submitting ? 0.5 : 1,
          }}
        >
          Back
        </button>
      )}
      <style>{`
        .ajrc-seniority-btn:active { transform: scale(0.99); background-color: ${SOFT}; }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

function CustomTaskStep({
  onContinue,
  onBack,
}: {
  onContinue: (entry: { text: string; rating: number } | null) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [rating, setRating] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  const hasText = trimmed.length > 0;
  const canContinue = !hasText || rating !== null;

  const handleContinue = () => {
    if (!canContinue) return;
    if (hasText && rating !== null) {
      onContinue({ text: trimmed.slice(0, 600), rating });
    } else {
      onContinue(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        maxWidth: 700,
        backgroundColor: "#fff",
        borderRadius: 20,
        padding: "40px 32px",
        boxShadow: "0 20px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
      }}
    >
      <h2
        className="font-display font-extrabold"
        style={{ color: CHARCOAL, fontSize: "clamp(24px, 3.4vw, 32px)", marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 1.2 }}
      >
        Add a task in your own words
      </h2>
      <p
        style={{
          color: CHARCOAL,
          fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
          fontSize: 15,
          lineHeight: 1.5,
          marginTop: 12,
        }}
      >
        Is there something you spend real time on that we did not list? Add one task, or skip this step.
      </p>

      <textarea
        value={text}
        onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value.slice(0, 600))}
        placeholder="Describe one task you do"
        rows={3}
        maxLength={600}
        autoComplete="off"
        autoCorrect="off"
        autoCapitalize="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        style={{
          marginTop: 20,
          width: "100%",
          padding: "12px 14px",
          fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
          fontSize: 16,
          color: CHARCOAL,
          border: "1px solid #E5E2DB",
          borderRadius: 10,
          outline: "none",
          background: "#fff",
          resize: "vertical",
          minHeight: 80,
        }}
      />
      <div
        style={{
          textAlign: "right",
          color: "#888",
          fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
          fontSize: 12,
          marginTop: 4,
        }}
      >
        {text.length}/600
      </div>

      {hasText && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              color: CHARCOAL,
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontWeight: 500,
              fontSize: 15,
              marginBottom: 10,
            }}
          >
            How much of your time does this take?
          </div>
          <TaskScale
            value={rating ?? -1}
            onChange={(v) => setRating(v)}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      <div
        className="step2-actions"
        style={{ marginTop: 24, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10 }}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBack}
          className="font-display font-extrabold"
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            height: 52,
            borderRadius: 12,
            backgroundColor: "transparent",
            color: TEAL,
            border: `2px solid ${TEAL}`,
            fontSize: 16,
            cursor: "pointer",
          }}
        >
          Back
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleContinue}
          disabled={!canContinue}
          className="font-display font-extrabold"
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            height: 52,
            borderRadius: 12,
            backgroundColor: AMBER,
            color: CHARCOAL,
            border: "none",
            fontSize: 16,
            cursor: canContinue ? "pointer" : "not-allowed",
            opacity: canContinue ? 1 : 0.6,
          }}
        >
          Continue
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 12, textAlign: "center" }}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onContinue(null)}
          style={{
            background: "transparent",
            border: "none",
            color: TEAL,
            fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 14,
            cursor: "pointer",
            textDecoration: "underline",
          }}
        >
          Skip for now
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const FAQS: { q: string; a: string }[] = [
  {

Your AI Job Risk Report shows you exactly which tasks in your job are exposed today, and which are coming next.",

A high score means a significant share of your work is already replicable by current AI tools.",
  },

import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { buildPageHead } from "@/lib/seo";
import { HeroJobForm } from "@/components/HeroJobForm";
import { supabase } from "@/lib/supabase";
import { Footer } from "@/components/Footer";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "@/components/Breadcrumbs";


export const Route = createFileRoute("/sample-report")({
  head: () =>
    buildPageHead({
      path: "/sample-report",
      title: "What Does an AI Job Risk Report Look Like?",
      description:
        "See a full example AI Job Risk Report: the task-level breakdown, the score, the three-year outlook, and the personalized action plan.",
      breadcrumbs: [
        { name: "Home", path: "/" },
        { name: "Sample Report", path: "/sample-report" },
      ],
    }),
  component: SampleReportPage,
});

const COLORS = {
  teal: "#0A6B70",
  tealTint: "#E8F0F0",
  soft: "#FAFAF8",
  charcoal: "#1B1B1B",
  amber: "#F4B400",
  muted: "#5F5E5A",
  red: "#EA4335",
  green: "#34A853",
  subCard: "#F5F5F4",
  divider: "#E5E5E5",
};

const BANDS = [
  { key: "minimal", label: "Minimal", from: 0, to: 19, color: "#34A853" },
  { key: "limited", label: "Limited", from: 20, to: 39, color: "#C0DD97" },
  { key: "moderate", label: "Moderate", from: 40, to: 59, color: "#F4B400" },
  { key: "significant", label: "Significant", from: 60, to: 79, color: "#F5A06B" },
  { key: "severe", label: "Severe", from: 80, to: 95, color: "#EA4335" },
] as const;

const DISPLAY = "'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
const SANS = "Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";

// ---------- Placeholder lines ----------
const PH_ANALYSIS = "Placeholder line standing in for the real analysis in your full report.";
const PH_TOOL = "Placeholder for a named tool and what it does for this task.";
const PH_STEP = "Placeholder for the concrete step described in your plan.";
const PH_OUTLOOK = "Placeholder for the directional three-year outlook for this task.";

const BLUR_STYLE: React.CSSProperties = {
  filter: "blur(4.5px)",
  userSelect: "none",
};

// ---------- Blurred score breakdown ----------
type BreakdownItem = { share_pct: number };

function BlurredBreakdown({ items, remainderPct }: { items: BreakdownItem[]; remainderPct?: number }) {
  const rows: { value: number }[] = items.map((i) => ({ value: i.share_pct }));
  if (remainderPct !== undefined && remainderPct > 0) rows.push({ value: remainderPct });

  const floors = rows.map((r) => Math.floor(r.value));
  const sumFloor = floors.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const diff = 100 - sumFloor;
  const fracs = rows.map((r, i) => ({ i, frac: r.value - Math.floor(r.value) }));
  const pct = floors.slice();
  if (diff > 0) {
    const order = [...fracs].sort((a, b) => b.frac - a.frac || a.i - b.i);
    for (let k = 0; k < diff && k < order.length; k++) pct[order[k].i] += 1;
  } else if (diff < 0) {
    const order = [...fracs].sort((a, b) => a.frac - b.frac || a.i - b.i);
    for (let k = 0; k < -diff && k < order.length; k++) pct[order[k].i] = Math.max(0, pct[order[k].i] - 1);
  }

  const total = items.length + (remainderPct !== undefined && remainderPct > 0 ? 1 : 0);

  return (
    <>
      <h2
        style={{
          fontFamily: DISPLAY,
          fontWeight: 800,
          fontSize: "clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px)",
          color: COLORS.teal,
          margin: "0 0 8px",
          lineHeight: 1.2,
        }}
      >
        Where your score comes from
      </h2>
      <p style={{ color: "#5f6360", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 400, margin: "0 0 20px", lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
        Each task you rated adds to your score based on how exposed it is to AI and how much of your time it takes. Here's how your tasks stack up.
      </p>
      {Array.from({ length: total }).map((_, i) => {
        const isRemainder = remainderPct !== undefined && remainderPct > 0 && i === items.length;
        return (
          <div key={i} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                aria-hidden="true"
                style={{
                  ...BLUR_STYLE,
                  flex: 1,
                  color: isRemainder ? "#5f6360" : COLORS.charcoal,
                  fontSize: 14.5,
                  lineHeight: 1.35,
                  fontWeight: 500,
                  fontStyle: isRemainder ? "italic" : "normal",
                }}
              >
                {PH_ANALYSIS}
              </div>
              <div
                style={{
                  color: isRemainder ? "#5f6360" : COLORS.charcoal,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: 14.5,
                  whiteSpace: "nowrap",
                }}
              >
                {pct[i]}%
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 6, width: "100%", height: 8, borderRadius: 4, background: "#E8E8E2" }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  height: 8,
                  borderRadius: 4,
                  background: isRemainder ? "rgba(10,107,112,0.45)" : COLORS.teal,
                  width: `${pct[i]}%`,
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

The 3-year outlook draws on current AI capability research and is reviewed every 6 months; treat it as directional, not as a numeric forecast.";

function SampleReportEmailCapture() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    const trimmed = email.trim();
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmed)) {
      setError("Please enter a valid email address.");
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const { error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc("app_add_to_email_list", {
        p_email: trimmed,
        p_source: "sample_report",
        p_occupation: null,
        p_score: null,
        p_risk_label: null,
        p_assessment_id: null,
      } as any);
      if (rpcErr) throw rpcErr;
      setDone(true);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("app_add_to_email_list (sample_report) failed:", err);
      setError("We couldn't save your email. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 460, margin: "24px auto 0", padding: "0 4px" }}>
      {done ? (
        <p
          style={{
            margin: 0,
            fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
            fontSize: 14,
            color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)",
            lineHeight: 1.5,
            textAlign: "center",
          }}
        >
          You're on the list. We'll send occasional updates on AI and how it's changing work like yours. No spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <p
            style={{
              margin: "0 0 10px",
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontSize: 13,
              color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)",
              lineHeight: 1.45,
              textAlign: "center",
            }}
          >
            Not ready? Get occasional updates instead.
          </p>
          <input
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="you@example.com"
            disabled={submitting}
            autoComplete="email"
            style={{
              display: "block",
              width: "100%",
              boxSizing: "border-box",
              padding: "11px 13px",
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontSize: 14,
              color: "#fff",
              background: "transparent",
              border: `1px solid ${error ? "#FFD1CE" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"}`,
              borderRadius: 8,
              outline: "none",
            }}
          />
          {error && (
            <p style={{ margin: "6px 0 0", color: "#FFD1CE", fontSize: 12, fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif" }}>
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            style={{
              display: "block",
              width: "100%",
              marginTop: 10,
              background: "transparent",
              color: "#fff",
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: 14,
              padding: "11px 16px",
              borderRadius: 8,
              border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6)",
              cursor: submitting ? "default" : "pointer",
              opacity: submitting ? 0.7 : 1,
            }}
          >
            {submitting ? "Saving…" : "Keep me posted"}
          </button>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


function ActionCard({ num, variant, withTime, time }: { num: string; variant: "today" | "build"; withTime?: boolean; time?: string }) {

    <div className="sr-action-card">

        </h4>

          <li key={i} aria-hidden="true" style={BLUR_STYLE}>
            {PH_STEP}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {withTime && (
        <div className="sr-time">
          <p className="sr-time-label">Time</p>
          {time ? (
            <p className="sr-time-text">{time}</p>
          ) : (
            <p className="sr-time-text" aria-hidden="true" style={BLUR_STYLE}>
              {PH_STEP}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------- Gauge ----------
function Gauge({ value }: { value: number }) {
  const W = 320, H = 210, cx = W / 2, cy = 175, r = 130, stroke = 22;
  const [animated, setAnimated] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const start = performance.now();
    const dur = 1500;
    let raf = 0;
    const tick = (t: number) => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (t - start) / dur);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      setAnimated(value * eased);
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [value]);
  const pctToAngle = (pct: number) => Math.PI * (1 - pct / 100);
  const pointAt = (pct: number, radius: number) => {
    const a = pctToAngle(pct);
    return { x: cx + radius * Math.cos(a), y: cy - radius * Math.sin(a) };
  };
  const gradId = "sr-gauge-grad";
  const startPt = pointAt(0, r);
  const endPt = pointAt(100, r);
  const arcPath = `M ${startPt.x} ${startPt.y} A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${endPt.x} ${endPt.y}`;
  const needle = pointAt(animated, r - stroke / 2 - 4);
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox={`-40 0 ${W + 80} ${H}`}
      preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
      overflow="visible"
      style={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: 420, height: "auto", display: "block", overflow: "visible" }}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`Risk score ${Math.round(value)} out of 100`}
    >
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={gradId} x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
          {BANDS.map((b) => {
            const mid = (b.from + b.to) / 2;
            return <stop key={b.key} offset={`${mid}%`} stopColor={b.color} />;
          })}
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <path d={arcPath} stroke="rgba(27,27,27,0.08)" strokeWidth={stroke + 2} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />
      <path d={arcPath} stroke={`url(#${gradId})`} strokeWidth={stroke} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />
      {BANDS.map((b) => {
        const mid = (b.from + b.to) / 2;
        const p = pointAt(mid, r + stroke / 2 + 4);
        return (
          <text key={b.key} x={p.x} y={p.y} fontSize={10} fill={b.color} textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="middle" fontFamily="Inter, sans-serif" fontWeight={700} style={{ letterSpacing: "0.03em" }}>
            {b.label}
          </text>
        );
      })}
      {[0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 95].map((tk) => {
        const a = pctToAngle(tk);
        const r1 = r - stroke / 2;
        const r2 = r + stroke / 2;
        return (
          <line key={tk} x1={cx + r1 * Math.cos(a)} y1={cy - r1 * Math.sin(a)} x2={cx + r2 * Math.cos(a)} y2={cy - r2 * Math.sin(a)} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.6)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
        );
      })}
      <line x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={needle.x} y2={needle.y} stroke={COLORS.charcoal} strokeWidth={3} strokeLinecap="round" />
      <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={7} fill={COLORS.charcoal} />
      <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={3} fill={COLORS.soft} />
    </svg>
  );
}

import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { buildPageHead } from "@/lib/seo";

import { HeroJobForm } from "@/components/HeroJobForm";
import { Footer } from "@/components/Footer";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "@/components/Breadcrumbs";

const TEAL = "#0A6B70";
const SOFT = "#FAFAF8";
const AMBER = "#F4B400";
const CHARCOAL = "#1B1B1B";
const DISPLAY = "'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
const SANS = "Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";

Say half your week goes to a task AI can already do on its own, a quarter to a task AI can handle with the right tools, and the last quarter to a task AI can't touch.                 <li style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>β<sub>i</sub> ("beta"), the AI-exposure value for task i, drawn from the Eloundou framework.</li>
                <li style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>w<sub>i</sub> ("weight"), how much of your time task i takes, from your five-point rating.</li>

The tasks you spend the most time on move your number the most, and the result is capped at 95 because no job today runs with zero human input.

import { createFileRoute, Link, notFound } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useState } from "react";
import { buildPageHead, DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE, SITE_URL } from "@/lib/seo";
import { supabase } from "@/lib/supabase";
import { HeroJobForm } from "@/components/HeroJobForm";
import { Footer } from "@/components/Footer";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "@/components/Breadcrumbs";

const TEAL = "#0A6B70";
const TEAL_DARK = "#085055";
const SOFT = "#FAFAF8";
const AMBER = "#F4B400";
const CHARCOAL = "#1B1B1B";

type Faq = { q: string; a: string };

type OccupationRow = {
  soc_code: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  representative_score: number;
  band: string;
  band_color: string;
  meta_title: string;
  meta_description: string;
  today: string;
  trend: string;
  faqs: Faq[];
};

function bandHex(color: string): string {
  const c = (color || "").toLowerCase();
  if (c === "green") return "#34A853";
  if (c === "red") return "#EA4335";
  return "#F4B400";
}

function pickVariant(seed: string, salt: number, options: string[]): string {
  let h = salt >>> 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + seed.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return options[h % options.length];
}

const SUBTITLE_VARIANTS = [
  "How much of this occupation today's AI can meaningfully do, and where it is heading.",
  "A task-level look at what AI can already do in this occupation, and what is likely to change next.",
  "Where today's AI already handles this occupation's tasks, and where that line is moving.",
];

const TODAY_HEADINGS = [
  "What AI can do today",
  "Where AI already fits this work",
  "What AI covers right now",
];

const OUTLOOK_HEADINGS = [
  "The outlook",
  "What the next few years look like",
  "Where this is heading",
];

const NUDGE_HEADINGS = [
  "This is the average. Yours is the one that matters.",
  "Averages describe the occupation. Your tasks decide your score.",
  "The occupation average is a starting point. Your number is personal.",
];

const NUDGE_BODY = [
  "Your real exposure depends on your specific task mix, and whether you do the work or manage people who do.",
  "Two people with this title can face very different risk. It comes down to which tasks fill your week, and whether you do them or supervise them.",
  "Your actual exposure follows your task mix. Doing the work and managing the people who do it carry different levels of risk.",
];

function typicalLine(row: OccupationRow): string {
  const options = [
    `This is the typical exposure for ${row.title} as a whole. Your personal exposure depends on your specific task mix.`,
    `This reflects ${row.title} overall, not any one desk. Your own mix of tasks sets your personal number.`,
    `Typical exposure for ${row.title} across the US. Your number depends on the tasks you actually spend time on.`,
  ];
  return pickVariant(row.slug, 1, options);
}

async function fetchOccupation(slug: string): Promise<OccupationRow | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .rpc("app_get_occupation_page", { p_slug: slug })
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error("app_get_occupation_page error:", error.message);
    return null;
  }
  return (data as OccupationRow | null) ?? null;
}

export const Route = createFileRoute("/ai-job-risk/$slug")({
  loader: async ({ params }) => {
    const row = await fetchOccupation(params.slug);
    return { row };
  },
  head: ({ loaderData, params }) => {
    const row = loaderData?.row;
    const slug = params?.slug ?? "";
    if (!row) {
      return buildPageHead({
        path: `/ai-job-risk/${slug}`,
        title: "Occupation not found | AI Job Risk Check",
        description: "This occupation page is not available.",
        noindex: true,
      });
    }
    const url = `${SITE_URL}/ai-job-risk/${row.slug}`;
    const webPage = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "WebPage",
      name: row.meta_title,
      description: row.meta_description,
      url,
      inLanguage: "en",
      publisher: { "@id": "https://aijobriskcheck.net/#organization" },
    };
    const breadcrumb = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
      itemListElement: [
        { "@type": "ListItem", position: 1, name: "Home", item: `${SITE_URL}/` },
        { "@type": "ListItem", position: 2, name: "AI Job Risk", item: `${SITE_URL}/ai-job-risk` },
        { "@type": "ListItem", position: 3, name: row.title, item: url },
      ],
    };
    const faqPage = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "FAQPage",
      mainEntity: (row.faqs ?? []).map((f) => ({
        "@type": "Question",
        name: f.q,
        acceptedAnswer: { "@type": "Answer", text: f.a },
      })),
    };
    return buildPageHead({
      path: `/ai-job-risk/${row.slug}`,
      title: row.meta_title,
      description: row.meta_description,
      ogType: "article",
      ogImage: DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE,
      jsonLd: [webPage, breadcrumb, faqPage],
    });
  },
  errorComponent: ({ error }) => (
    <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: TEAL, color: SOFT, padding: 32, fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif" }}>
      <p>Something went wrong loading this page.</p>
      <p style={{ opacity: 0.75, fontSize: 13 }}>We couldn't load this page right now. Please refresh.</p>
      <Link to="/" style={{ color: AMBER, fontWeight: 700 }}>Back to home</Link>
    </div>
  ),
  notFoundComponent: NotFoundView,
  component: OccupationPage,
});

function NotFoundView() {
  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: TEAL, color: SOFT, fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: 24 }}>
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center", maxWidth: 420 }}>
        <h1 style={{ fontFamily: "'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 28, margin: "0 0 12px", color: SOFT }}>
          Occupation not found
        </h1>
        <p style={{ margin: "0 0 24px", opacity: 0.9 }}>
          We could not find a published page for this occupation.
        </p>
        <Link to="/" style={{ display: "inline-block", background: AMBER, color: CHARCOAL, fontFamily: "'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif", fontWeight: 800, padding: "12px 24px", borderRadius: 10, textDecoration: "none" }}>
          Back to home
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function paragraphs(text: string) {
  return text
    .split(/\n\s*\n/)
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function FaqAccordion({
  faqs,
  title,
  headingFont,
  cardStyle,
}: {
  faqs: Faq[];
  title: string;
  headingFont: React.CSSProperties;
  cardStyle: React.CSSProperties;
}) {
  const [openSet, setOpenSet] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set([0]));

  const toggle = (i: number) => {
    setOpenSet((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(i)) next.delete(i);
      else next.add(i);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <section style={cardStyle}>
      <h2 style={{ ...headingFont, color: CHARCOAL, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 22, margin: "0 0 12px" }}>
        FAQs about the role of AI for {title}
      </h2>
      {faqs.map((f, i) => {
        const isOpen = openSet.has(i);
        return (
          <details
            key={i}
            open={isOpen}
            style={{ borderTop: i === 0 ? "none" : "0.5px solid rgba(27,27,27,.1)" }}
          >
            <summary
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggle(i);
              }}
              style={{
                listStyle: "none",
                display: "flex",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 12,
                padding: "14px 0",
                fontFamily: headingFont.fontFamily,
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: 16,
                color: CHARCOAL,
                cursor: "pointer",
              }}
            >
              {f.q}
              <span
                style={{
                  color: TEAL,
                  fontFamily: headingFont.fontFamily,
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  fontSize: 22,
                  lineHeight: 1,
                  flex: "none",
                }}
              >
                {isOpen ? "-" : "+"}
              </span>
            </summary>
            <p
              style={{
                margin: 0,
                color: CHARCOAL,
                fontSize: 15,
                lineHeight: 1.55,
                padding: "0 0 16px",
              }}
            >
              {f.a}
            </p>
          </details>
        );
      })}
    </section>
  );
}

function OccupationPage() {
  const { row } = Route.useLoaderData();
  if (!row) return <NotFoundView />;

  const accent = bandHex(row.band_color);
  const bandLabel = `${row.band.toUpperCase()} exposure`;

  const headingFont: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, sans-serif" };
  const cardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    background: SOFT,
    color: CHARCOAL,
    borderRadius: 16,
    padding: "22px 20px",
    boxShadow: "0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.14)",
  };
  
  const nudgeCardStyle: React.CSSProperties = { ...cardStyle, borderRadius: 12 };

  return (
    <div style={{ background: TEAL, minHeight: "100vh", fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", color: SOFT }}>
      <main style={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: 720, margin: "0 auto", padding: "32px 16px 56px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 18 }}>
        {/* Hero */}
        <header style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "8px 0 8px" }}>
          <Breadcrumbs
            items={[
              { name: "Home", path: "/" },
              { name: "AI Job Risk", path: "/ai-job-risk" },
              { name: row.title, path: `/ai-job-risk/${row.slug}` },
            ]}
            variant="dark"
            style={{ textAlign: "center" }}
          />
          <h1 style={{ ...headingFont, color: AMBER, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: "clamp(28px, 5vw, 36px)", lineHeight: 1.15, margin: 0 }}>
            Will AI replace {row.title}?
          </h1>
          <p style={{ color: SOFT, opacity: 0.9, margin: "12px auto 0", maxWidth: 44 + "ch", fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
            {pickVariant(row.slug, 0, SUBTITLE_VARIANTS)}
          </p>
        </header>

        {/* Top card */}
        <section style={cardStyle} aria-label="Typical AI exposure">
          <p
            style={{
              ...headingFont,
              color: TEAL,
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: 11,
              letterSpacing: "0.05em",
              margin: "0 0 10px",
              textTransform: "uppercase",
            }}
          >
            TYPICAL AI EXPOSURE
          </p>
          <span
            style={{
              display: "inline-block",
              background: accent,
              color: SOFT,
              fontFamily: headingFont.fontFamily,
              fontWeight: 800,
              fontSize: 14,
              padding: "6px 14px",
              borderRadius: 999,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              letterSpacing: 0.5,
            }}
          >
            {bandLabel}
          </span>
          <p style={{ margin: "12px 0 0", color: "rgba(27,27,27,.7)", fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
            {typicalLine(row)}
          </p>
        </section>

        {/* Today */}
        <section style={cardStyle}>
          <h2 style={{ ...headingFont, color: CHARCOAL, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 22, margin: "0 0 12px" }}>
            {pickVariant(row.slug, 2, TODAY_HEADINGS)}
          </h2>
          {paragraphs(row.today).map((p, i) => (
            <p key={i} style={{ margin: i === 0 ? 0 : "12px 0 0", color: CHARCOAL, fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
              {p}
            </p>
          ))}
        </section>

        {/* Trend */}
        <section style={cardStyle}>
          <h2 style={{ ...headingFont, color: CHARCOAL, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 22, margin: "0 0 12px" }}>
            {pickVariant(row.slug, 3, OUTLOOK_HEADINGS)}
          </h2>
          {paragraphs(row.trend).map((p, i) => (
            <p key={i} style={{ margin: i === 0 ? 0 : "12px 0 0", color: CHARCOAL, fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
              {p}
            </p>
          ))}
        </section>

        {/* FAQs */}
        <FaqAccordion faqs={row.faqs} title={row.title} headingFont={headingFont} cardStyle={cardStyle} />

        {/* Nudge card */}
        <section style={nudgeCardStyle}>
          <h2 style={{ ...headingFont, color: CHARCOAL, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 22, margin: "0 0 12px" }}>
            {pickVariant(row.slug, 4, NUDGE_HEADINGS)}
          </h2>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, color: "rgba(27,27,27,.7)", fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
            {pickVariant(row.slug, 5, NUDGE_BODY)}
          </p>
        </section>
      </main>

      {/* Footer CTA */}
      <section style={{ backgroundColor: TEAL_DARK, paddingTop: 48, paddingBottom: 56 }}>
        <div
          style={{
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: 800,
            margin: "0 auto",
            paddingLeft: "clamp(16px, 2vw, 32px)",
            paddingRight: "clamp(16px, 2vw, 32px)",
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ maxWidth: 520, margin: "0 auto", textAlign: "center" }}>
            <h2
              style={{
                ...headingFont,
                color: SOFT,
                fontWeight: 800,
                fontSize: "clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px)",
                margin: 0,
                marginBottom: 20,
              }}
            >
              Get your free AI Job Risk Score
            </h2>
            <HeroJobForm />
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <Footer />
    </div>
  );
}
