  "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6ImpkZHlndnRveWFmZXdrcnJobmRrIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODUzNTEzNzksImV4cCI6MjEwMDkyNzM3OX0.mSoqQmYDoPQPrqEJKqbqgOfj4cZCtpT60qRHskHIVLc";
const OUT_ROOT = "public/ai-job-risk";
const SITE = "https://aijobriskcheck.net";

const C = {
  teal: "#0A6B70",
  tealDark: "#085055",
  soft: "#FAFAF8",
  amber: "#F4B400",
  charcoal: "#1B1B1B",
};
const BAND = {
  green: { bg: "#34A853", fg: C.soft },
  amber: { bg: "#F4B400", fg: C.charcoal },
  red: { bg: "#EA4335", fg: C.soft },
};

const esc = (s) =>
  String(s ?? "")
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;");
const cap = (s) => (s ? s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : s);
const pickVariant = (seed, salt, options) => {
  let h = salt >>> 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + seed.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return options[h % options.length];
};

const SUB_VARIANTS = [
  "How much of this job can AI already do, and where it's heading.",
  "A task-level look at what AI can already do in this line of work, and what is likely to change next.",
  "Where AI already covers parts of this job, and where that line is moving.",
];
const TODAY_HEADINGS = ["Today", "What AI can do now", "Where AI stands today"];
const TREND_HEADINGS = ["Where it's heading", "The next few years", "What's coming"];
const AVG_HEADINGS = [
  "This is the average. Yours is the one that matters.",
  "Averages describe the occupation. Your tasks decide your score.",
  "The average is a starting point. Your number is personal.",
];
const REAL_VARIANTS = [
  "Your real exposure depends on your specific task mix, and whether you do the work or manage people who do.",
  "Two people with this title can face very different risk. It comes down to which tasks fill your week, and whether you do them or supervise them.",
  "Your actual exposure follows your task mix. Doing the work and managing the people who do it carry different levels of risk.",
];

function bandColors(v) {
  if (!v) return BAND.amber;
  if (v.startsWith("#")) return { bg: v, fg: v.toUpperCase() === "#F4B400" ? C.charcoal : C.soft };
  return BAND[v] || BAND.amber;
}

function faqItem(q, answerHtml, open) {
  return `<details${open ? " open" : ""} style="border-bottom:1px solid #E5E5E0;padding:16px 0;">
<summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:${C.charcoal};list-style:none;">${q}</summary>
<div style="margin-top:8px;color:${C.charcoal};line-height:1.6;">${answerHtml}</div>
</details>`;
}

function pageHtml(row) {
  const band = bandColors(row.band_color);
  const bandLabel = `${esc(cap(row.band))} exposure`;
  const title = esc(row.title);
  const genFaqs = Array.isArray(row.faqs) ? row.faqs : [];
  const fixedFaq = {
    q: "Is this my personal job risk?",
    a: "No. This is the baseline for the occupation as a whole. Your own risk depends on how you actually spend your week and whether you do the work or manage people who do, which is what the free check measures.",
  };
  const allFaqsForLd = [...genFaqs.map((f) => ({ q: f.q, a: f.a })), fixedFaq];
  const faqHtml =
    genFaqs.map((f, i) => faqItem(esc(f.q), esc(f.a), i === 0)).join("\n") +
    "\n" +
    faqItem(
      esc(fixedFaq.q),
      `No. This is the baseline for the occupation as a whole. Your own risk depends on how you actually spend your week and whether you do the work or manage people who do, which is what the free check measures.`,
      false,
    );
  const jsonLd = JSON.stringify({
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "FAQPage",
    mainEntity: allFaqsForLd.map((f) => ({
      "@type": "Question",
      name: f.q,
      acceptedAnswer: { "@type": "Answer", text: f.a },
    })),
  }).replaceAll("<", "\\u003c");
  const canonical = `${SITE}/ai-job-risk/${row.slug}`;
  const ctaSection =
    row.slug === "floral-designers"
      ? `
<section style="background:${C.tealDark};padding-top:48px;padding-bottom:56px;">
  <div style="width:100%;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:clamp(16px, 2vw, 32px);padding-right:clamp(16px, 2vw, 32px);">
    <div style="max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;">
      <h2 style="font-family:&quot;Plus Jakarta Sans&quot;,Inter,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);color:${C.soft};margin:0 0 20px;">Get your free AI Job Risk Score</h2>
      <form action="/assessment" method="GET" style="width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">
        <input type="text" name="title" placeholder="What's your job title?" aria-label="Your job title" autocomplete="off" autocorrect="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" style="width:100%;padding:18px 20px;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:500;color:${C.charcoal};background:${C.soft};border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;outline:none;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:56px;" />
        <button type="submit" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:${C.amber};color:${C.charcoal};font-family:&quot;Plus Jakarta Sans&quot;,Inter,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;padding:16px 32px;border-radius:10px;border:none;cursor:pointer;width:100%;min-height:56px;line-height:1.1;">Get My Free Score</button>
        <p style="font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);margin:0;text-align:center;">Free. 60 seconds. No sign-up.</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>`
      : "";
  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
<title>${esc(row.meta_title)}</title>
<meta name="description" content="${esc(row.meta_description)}"/>
<link rel="canonical" href="${canonical}"/>
<meta property="og:title" content="${esc(row.meta_title)}"/>
<meta property="og:description" content="${esc(row.meta_description)}"/>
<meta property="og:url" content="${canonical}"/>
<meta property="og:type" content="article"/>
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.png"/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;700&display=swap"/>
<!-- Privacy-friendly analytics by Plausible -->
<script async src="https://plausible.io/js/pa-0aQ4WtA2HVkJzcDHiKx2k.js"></script>
<script>
  window.plausible=window.plausible||function(){(plausible.q=plausible.q||[]).push(arguments)},plausible.init=plausible.init||function(i){plausible.o=i||{}};
  plausible.init()
</script>
<script type="application/ld+json">${jsonLd}</script>
<style>
body{margin:0;background:${C.teal};color:${C.soft};font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;}
.wrap{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 20px 64px;}
h1{font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",Inter,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:32px;line-height:1.15;margin:24px 0 8px;color:${C.soft};}
.sub{color:#D7E6E7;margin:0 0 24px;}
.card{background:${C.soft};color:${C.charcoal};border-radius:16px;padding:20px;margin:16px 0;}
.card h2{margin:0 0 12px;font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",Inter,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;}
.pill{display:inline-block;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;background:${band.bg};color:${band.fg};margin-bottom:12px;}
.cta{display:block;text-align:center;background:${C.amber};color:${C.charcoal};font-weight:700;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;margin-top:12px;}
.muted{color:#6B6B66;font-size:14px;margin-top:8px;}
a.link{color:${C.teal};font-weight:700;}
header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);}
header span{font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",Inter,sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:${C.soft};}
footer{background:${C.tealDark};color:#C9D9DA;padding:32px 20px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;}
footer a{color:#C9D9DA;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><a href="/" aria-label="AI Job Risk Check home" style="display:inline-flex"><img src="/logo-horizontal.png" alt="AI Job Risk Check" style="height:34px;width:auto;display:block"/></a></header>
<main class="wrap">
<h1>${title}</h1>
<p class="sub">${pickVariant(row.slug, 0, SUB_VARIANTS)}</p>
<section class="card">
<h2>${pickVariant(row.slug, 2, TODAY_HEADINGS)}</h2>
<span class="pill">${bandLabel}</span>
<p>${esc(row.today)}</p>
</section>
<section class="card">
<h2>${pickVariant(row.slug, 3, TREND_HEADINGS)}</h2>
<p>${esc(row.trend)}</p>
</section>
<section class="card">
<h2>FAQs about the role of AI for ${title}</h2>
${faqHtml}
</section>
<section class="card">
<h2>${pickVariant(row.slug, 4, AVG_HEADINGS)}</h2>
<p>${pickVariant(row.slug, 5, REAL_VARIANTS)}</p>
<a class="cta" href="/">Get my free score</a>
<p class="muted">Free. 60 seconds. No sign-up.</p>
</section>
<section class="card">
<h2>How we calculate this</h2>
<p>Scores are built from O*NET task data for each occupation and the Eloundou et al. AI-exposure framework, which rates how much of each task today's AI can meaningfully do.</p>
<p><a class="link" href="/how-it-works">See how it works</a></p>
</section>
</main>
${ctaSection}
<footer>
<p><strong>AI Job Risk Check</strong></p>
<p><a href="/">Home</a> · <a href="/how-it-works">How It Works</a> · <a href="/sample-report">Sample Report</a> · <a href="/faqs">FAQs</a></p>
<p>© 2026 AI Job Risk Check. All rights reserved.</p>
<p><a href="/privacy">Privacy</a> · <a href="/terms">Terms</a> · <a href="/refunds">Refunds</a> · <a href="/disclaimer">Disclaimer</a> · <a href="/contact">Contact</a></p>
</footer>
</body>
</html>`;
}

async function main() {
  const url = `${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/occupation_pages?select=slug,title,band,band_color,today,trend,faqs,meta_title,meta_description&status=eq.published`;
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_ANON, Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_ANON}` },
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Supabase fetch failed: ${res.status} ${await res.text()}`);
  const rows = await res.json();
  console.log(`[prerender] fetched ${rows.length} published occupation pages`);
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!row.slug) continue;
    const outPath = join(OUT_ROOT, row.slug, "index.html");
    await mkdir(dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(outPath, pageHtml(row), "utf8");
  }
  console.log(`[prerender] wrote ${rows.length} static pages`);
}
main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
